REPORT

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - activities of workers' Union.

Made by D.P.S. Lingard Forwarded by Whounean DSS

On may 23, a coolie G.O. 39 of the no.4 boiler
Room of the Riverside Power Station reported to the
Management of the Shanghai Power Company that he had been
assaulted and slightly injured by a Russian employee R.D.E.3,
The Watchman R.D.E.3 denied the allegation and there being
no definite proof of the assault, no further action was
taken in the matter by the management.

On may 26 and 27, the coolie visited the 4th District
Water & Electricity Workers' Union, 117 Foh you Road, City,
and solicited assistance. The Union authorities
advised him to file a private criminal prosecution against
the Russian Employee.

Nine member of the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union held a meeting in their office, 117 Foh You
Road, City, between 4 p.m. and 5.40 p.m. May 26. Chu Ah-
sien (朱阿全), committee member and concurrently Chief of the
General Affairs Department of the Union, presided. The
chief matter to be discussed at the meeting was that of
the payment of the workers' loans.:

It was pointed out that the Union, in supporting
the suggestion that these loans should be deducted from the
workers' superannuation had lost a certain amount of prestige,
since at the conclusion of the strike in 1933 they had promised
to approach the management, and persuade them not to deduct
these loans under any circumstances. In order to avoid any
further loss of prestige, it was decided to appeal to Tu Yaeh-
sung through the medium of Chu Hsueh Van to request the
management of the S.P.C. to refrain from deducting any of the

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工人工会活动。

由副督察长 Lingard 撰写，由 Whounean 副助理总监转呈

5 月 23 日，江边发电站 4 号锅炉房的一名苦力 G.O. 39 向上海电力公司管理层报告称，他遭到一名俄籍雇员 R.D.E.3 的袭击并受轻伤。看守人 R.D.E.3 否认了这一指控，由于没有确凿的袭击证据，管理层未对此事采取进一步行动。

5 月 26 日和 27 日，该苦力前往位于市内福州路 117 号的第四区水电工人工会寻求援助。工会当局建议他对那名俄籍雇员提起私人刑事诉讼。

5 月 26 日下午 4 时至 5 时 40 分之间，第四区水电工人工会的九名成员在位于市内福州路 117 号的办公室举行会议。工会委员兼总务部主任朱阿全 (Chu Ah-sien) 主持会议。会议讨论的主要事项是工人贷款的偿还问题：

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company. - meeting of workers' union.

Made by D.P.S. Lingard Forwarded by Wrouncean OSS

The 4th. District Water & Electricity Workers' Union,
117 Foh Yeu Road, City, issued copies of a notification to the
workers of the Shanghai Power Company on May 19th. and 20th. 1934.
The document repeats the union's decision to collect $0.10.
from each worker towards a fund for Compassionate Grants.
The Union has resolved to collect same from such workers as have
not already subscribed, at the same time as they collect the
membership fees for the current term.
The notification concludes by exhorting the workers to
pay their subscriptions without delay.

D.P.S. Lingard

Date May 18 1934

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY. 5310 D Date 18 / 5 / 34）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Deductions of Workers' Loans.

Made by D. P. S. Lingard Forwarded by

The following is an exact copy of a notice
which was posted for the Shanghai Power Company, in all
its departments, this morning :-

"Notice to Employees"

" Many of the employees have asked that
"they be relieved of paying back their loans
"monthly and that the loan be deducted from
"their gratuities.

" To assist the employees the Company will
"not make monthly deductions to repay loans
"and instead the loans will be repaid by
"deductions from gratuities or any other
"moneys due the employee when leaving the
"Company's service for any reason whatever.

Shanghai Power Company
by W.S.Heald (signed)
Vice-President & General Manager.

"May 16, 1934."

This notice, which is self explanatory, will
in the opinion of the management tend to ensure satisfaction
amongst all the workers concerned, since a letter was
received by the management from the workers on May 7 asking
for terms as agreed to in the notice posted to-day.

（批：file Do D R Guts）

M R Lingard
D. P. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 扣除工人贷款。

由 D. P. S. Lingard 撰写，由 [空白] 转呈

以下是今早张贴在上海电力公司所有部门的通知的确切副本：-

“致员工通知”

“许多员工要求免除每月偿还贷款，
“并将贷款从其酬金中扣除。

“为了帮助员工，公司将
“不再每月扣款以偿还贷款，
“而是将在员工因任何原因离开
“公司服务时，从其酬金或应付给员工的
“任何其他款项中扣除以偿还贷款。

上海电力公司
W.S.Heald（签名）
副总裁兼总经理。

“1934 年 5 月 16 日。”

这份通知不言自明，管理层认为，这将有助于确保所有相关工人的满意，因为管理层在 5 月 7 日收到工人来信，要求按照今日张贴的通知中所同意的条款办理。

（批注：归档 Do D R Guts）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Activities of Workers' Union.

Made by D.P.S. Lingard Forwarded by Wrounson DSS

Some 20 members of the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union held a meeting in their office, 117 Foh Yeu
Road, City, between 3.40 p.m. and 5.45 p.m. on May 12. Chang
Pao-tai (張寶泰), a committee member, presided. The
following decisions were made :-
1. To make representations to Chu Hsueh-fan in order to urge
him to request Tu Yueh-sung to negotiate with the management
of the Shanghai Power Company in the matter of the workers'
request to have the loan of one month's pay deducted
from their superannuation fund.
2. To request the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social
Affairs to assist the Union forthwith in opposing the
Regulations Governing the Conduct of Workers issued by
the Shanghai Power Company.

In compliance with the abovementioned decisions,
five committee members of the Union visited the Shanghai
Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang Road, at 7.30 p.m. on May 13
when Chu Hsueh-fan promised to do his best to assist them.

D.P.S. Lingard
D. P. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工人工会活动。

由副督察长 Lingard 撰写，由 Wrounson 副助理总监转呈

5 月 12 日下午 3 时 40 分至 5 时 45 分之间，第四区水电工人工会约 20 名成员在位于市内福州路 117 号的办公室举行会议。委员張寶泰 (Chang Pao-tai) 主持会议。作出以下决定：-
1. 向朱学范 (Chu Hsueh-fan) 提出交涉，敦促他请求杜月笙 (Tu Yueh-sung) 就工人要求将一个月工资的贷款从养老金基金中扣除一事，与上海电力公司管理层进行谈判。
2. 请求当地国民党及社会局立即协助工会，反对上海电力公司发布的《工人行为管理条例》。

根据上述决定，工会五名委员于 5 月 13 日晚 7 时 30 分访问了位于九江路 545 号的上海劳工俱乐部，当时朱学范答应尽力协助他们。

副督察长 Lingard

Date May 7th 1934

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Workers' Union holds meeting.

Made by D. P. S. Lingard Forwarded by Wh Ounean DSS

Some 15 members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union held a secret meeting in the Shanghai
Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang Road, between 7 p.m. and 8 p.m.
May 5. Chang Pao-tai, a committee member, presided. - The
following resolutions were adopted at the gathering :-

1. That in view of the fact that the majority of the workers
of the Shanghai Power Company refuse to pay their membership
fees which are in arrears, the General Labour Union be
requested to urge foremen of the various departments, by
sending them warning letters, to collect without delay, the
money owing by their subordinates.

2. That further efforts be made to collect $0.10 from each
worker, towards a fund for compassionate grants to be paid
in future to families of deceased workers.

（批：Juli DC D）
（批：cont HB）

日期 1934 年 5 月 7 日

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工人工会举行会议。

由 D. P. S. Lingard 撰写，由 Wh Ounean 副助理总监转呈

5 月 5 日晚 7 时至 8 时之间，第四区水电工人工会约 15 名成员在位于九江路 545 号的上海劳工俱乐部举行秘密会议。委员 Chang Pao-tai 主持会议。- 会议上通过了以下决议：-

1. 鉴于上海电力公司大多数工人拒绝缴纳拖欠的会费，请求总工会通过发送警告信的方式，敦促各部门领班立即向其下属收取欠款。

2. 继续努力向每位工人收取 0.10 美元，作为抚恤金基金，用于未来支付给已故工人的家属。

（批注：Juli DC D）

Date. May 3rd 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY. File No. 5310/1 Date 3/5/34）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Activities of
Workers' Union.

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by W. Duncan DS.

The scheduled meeting of foremen of various
departments of the Shanghai Power Company on the evening of
May 2 in the Shanghai Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang Road
failed to materialize owing to lack of attendance. This
meeting was convened by the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union with the object of having a letter requesting
deduction of the loan of one month's pay from the workers'
superannuation fund, signed by the attendance.
Only four members of the Union attended but no
matters appertaining to the above were discussed.
It is reported that the Union intends to again
convene this meeting for this evening, May 3. The venue
however is not yet known but enquiries as to the rendezvous
are going forward.
Investigation shows that the Union is preparing
to send the letter signed by the foremen to Tu Yueh-sung
through the medium of Chu Hsueh-fan for the purpose of
requesting Tu to forward it together with his letter to the
Company. This action is being adopted instead of the Union
despatching them to the Company as had been previously
arranged.

D. S. Pitts.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（签名）

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工人工会活动。

由 D. S. Pitts 撰写，由 W. Duncan 助理总监转呈。

原定于 5 月 2 日晚在九江路 545 号上海劳工俱乐部举行的上海电力公司各部门领班会议，因出席人数不足而未成行。此次会议由第四区水电工人工会召集，目的是让出席者签署一封信，请求从工人养老金基金中扣除一个月工资的贷款。
只有四名工会成员出席，但未讨论上述相关事宜。
据报，工会打算再次于今晚，即 5 月 3 日召集此会议。然而，地点尚不清楚，但正在查询集会地点。
调查显示，工会正准备将这封由领班签署的信件通过朱学范 (Chu Hsueh-fan) 转交给杜月笙 (Tu Yueh-sung)，目的是请求杜月笙将此信连同他的信一起发送给公司。采取这一行动是为了替代工会此前安排的直接向公司发送信件的做法。

D. S. Pitts.
D. S.

特务处主管警官。
（签名）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Activities of Workers' Union.

Made by D. S. Pitts    Forwarded by W. Ouncman Esq.

The 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City, claims to have succeeded,
through the medium of Chu Hsueh-fan, in persuading Tu
Yueh-sung, Ling Kong-hou, Yuan Lu-tung and Yu Yah-ching
to write a joint letter addressed to the management of
the Shanghai Power Company requesting it to deduct the
loan of one month's pay granted to workers at the close of
the strike in 1933, from the workers' superannuation fund.
The Union intends to send the above mentioned letter, which
however has not yet been received by the Union, together
with another letter of the same nature which will be signed
by the foremen of the Company's various departments, to
the Company on May 3 or 4.

The Union is arranging to convene a dinner party
for the foremen in the Shanghai Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang
Road, on the evening of May 2, when the abovementioned
second letter will be shown them and properly signed and/or
chopped.

D. S. Pitts
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 工人工会活动。

由 D. S. Pitts 撰写    由 W. Ouncman 先生转呈

第四区水电工人工会（位于市内福州路 117 号）声称，通过朱学范 (Chu Hsueh-fan) 的媒介，成功说服杜月笙 (Tu Yueh-sung)、凌孔侯 (Ling Kong-hou)、袁履登 (Yuan Lu-tung) 和虞洽卿 (Yu Yah-ching) 联名致信上海电力公司管理层，请求将 1933 年罢工结束时授予工人的一个月工资贷款从工人养老金基金中扣除。工会打算于 5 月 3 日或 4 日将上述信件（尽管工会尚未收到）连同另一封性质相同、将由公司各部门领班签署的信件一并发送给公司。

工会正安排于 5 月 2 日晚在九江路 545 号的上海劳工俱乐部为领班们举办晚宴，届时将向他们出示上述第二封信并进行正式签署和/或盖章。

Eight committee members of the 4th District
Water & Electricity Workers' Union met in their office,
117 Foh Yeu Road, City, between 4 p.m. and 5.30 p.m.
April 28. Chu Ah-zien (朱阿泉) presided. The
following resolutions were adopted at the meeting :-
1. That further representations be made to Chu Hsueh-fan
with a view to asking him to approach Tu Yueh-sung
and other notables to write a joint letter to the
management of the Shanghai Power Company recommending

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by W. Duncan D.S.P.

Eight members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City,
interviewed Chu Hsueh-fan, committee member of the General
Labour Union, in the Shanghai Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by Whouncan OFF

(批：Information obtained by OOS 156 & Agent 53)

Some ten members of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union held a meeting in their office,
15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong Road, Chapei, between
4 p.m. and 5.30 p.m. March 17, 1934. Chu Ah-zai (朱阿才),
a committee member of the Union, presided. The following
resolutions were passed :-
1. That Hsu Hung-sung (徐鸿生), an ex-committee member of
the Union and at present a Union employee, be requested
to withdraw his resignation (which was tendered as the
result of the non-payment of Union fees by the workers).
2. That the local Kuomintang be requested to assist the
Union in organizing a "Labourers' Savings Control
Committee".
3. That a meeting of foremen of various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company, be convened for 3 p.m. March 24
in the Union's offices, the object being to urge them
to advise the workers to pay their membership fees in
arrears.

That the Union is finding itself in difficulties
as regards control exercised over the Company's workers
is more than evidenced by a tentative scheme, which by its
attractiveness, it is hoped to induce the workers to pay
their membership fees. The details of this scheme,
which are as follows, have been drawn up by the 4th District
Water & Electricity Workers' Union and passed to the notice
of the workers of the Shanghai Power Company through the
medium of the foremen of its various departments :-
1. Each worker voluntarily gives the Union $1.00 per month.

1934年3月17日下午4时至5时30分之间，第四区水电工会约十名成员在位于闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的该会办公室举行会议。工会委员朱阿才主持。通过了以下决议：-
1. 请求前工会委员、现任工会职员的徐鸿生撤回其辞呈（该辞呈是因工人未缴纳工会会费而提出的）。

工会在对公司工人行使控制权方面正陷入困境，这一点由一项试探性方案充分证实，希望通过该方案的吸引力来促使工人缴纳会费。该方案的细节如下，由第四区水电工会制定，并通过公司各部门领班的媒介传达给上海电力公司的工人：-
1. 每名工人自愿每月向工会缴纳1.00美元。

the medium of Shun Sung (顺生), the foreman of the No.2

According to old hands in the Riverside Station,
a new worker in the Boiler House is compelled to pay $30.00
or give a gift coupon to that value to the foreman, otherwise
faults are very soon found with the work performed by the
new hand. A definite instance of this nature has now
come to light as follows :-
A new man started working in the Boiler House
as recently as January, and refusing to pay the foreman
the usual "squeeze" of $30.00 he was assigned difficult
tasks by the latter. More recently, one of the foreign
staff of the company, a Mr. Malcolm, continually came to
the new man's side and very closely supervised his work,
with the result that the new hand is definitely under the
impression that the foreman must have spoken ill of him
to the foreigner, or in plain language, because he refused
to submit to the recognized demands of the foreman by
paying him "squeeze", this foreman is attempting to "fix"
him.
Further enquiries are going forward in an
effort to ascertain more of the activities of the responsible
members of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union.

Between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m. March 10, 1934,

some 70 Chinese claiming to represent workers of the Fearon
Road and Riverside Power Station held a meeting in the

membership dues, the local Kuomintang and the Bureau
of Social Affairs be requested to strictly deal with
them.

worker for the relief of men dismissed in the strike of
1933, as resolved by the Union, efforts to collect
and
membership fees in arrears from members be exerted/that
the proceeds minus Union expenses be donated for the
relief of the ex-workers in question.

仍不缴纳会费的任何工人发出警告。
c) 若有工人坚持拒绝缴纳会费，则请求当地

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by W. Duncan D.S.

Information Obtained by Agent 55.
Some ten committee members of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union held a meeting in their office, 15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong Road, Chapei, between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m. March 8, when the following resolutions were discussed and passed :-

2. Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - situation among the
workers.
Made by D. S. Pitts. Forwarded by Whouncan D.S.J.

Observation shows that the majority of workers at the
Riverside and Fearon Road Power Stations are either dis-
satisfied with or opposing the 4th. District Water and
Electricity Workers' Union, No. 15 Shou Ying Fang, Tien
Doong Road, Chapei, on the grounds that the Union did not
secure anything beneficial for the workers during the strike
of 1933. This is evidenced by the fact that a large num-
ber of workers have flatly refused to continue the payment
of membership fees. It is also learned that a certain por-
tion of these workers are influenced by communistic elements
and are forming an organ with the object of overthrowing the
Union sponsored by the Kuomintang. Recently the leaders
of the Kuomintang Union, namely, Yang Shao-keng, Peng Keng-
ling, etc., have been holding daily meetings with Chu Hsueh-
fan, a committee member of the General Labour Union, in the
offices of the Dah Kung News Agency, No. 46 Hankow Road, to
discuss ways and means of saving the Union. It is also of
significance to note that the Union has petitioned the local
Kuomintang for assistance in suppressing any reactionary
movement and investigating and taking into custody any re-
actionary.

D. S. Pitts.
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

Date February 10, 1934.
Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Workers' Union issues
Notification.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Wrouncon DSJ

It has been learned from a confidential source
that the Shanghai Power Company are anticipating the
signing of an agreement between them and the Chinese
Authorities referring to a "Franchise" in the Western
District of Shanghai, hitherto in dispute. It has also
come to light that negotiations are at present in progress
with the Hongkong Shanghai Bank for the financing of a
loan of $5,000,000.00. It is not known at present to
what purpose this sum will be put, but it is believed to
have been earmarked for the expansion of the Western
District Property.

The Company at present are unable to remove any
of their power units at the Riverside Power Station for
overhaul owing to the necessity of keeping the supply of
energy normal during the peak periods. To offset this,
the management have ordered either one or two more units
from America and expect to have them working by July 1, 1934.

It will be seen that it would not be to the
advantage of the Company to precipitate a strike at the
present time, they therefore have postponed the collection
of the loan from the workers until July, 1934.

据密报获悉，
上海电力公司预计将与中方当局就此前一直存在争议的上海西区“特许经营权”签署协议。另悉，目前正与汇丰银行进行谈判，以筹措一笔5,000,000.00美元的贷款。目前尚不清楚这笔款项的具体用途，但据信已指定用于扩充西区产业。

由于在高峰时段必须保持正常供电，该公司目前无法将江边发电站的任何发电机组停机检修。为弥补这一情况，管理层已向美国订购了一至两台新机组，并预计于1934年7月1日前投入运行。

由此可见，此时引发罢工对公司不利，因此他们已将向工人收回贷款的时间推迟至1934年7月。

January 28, 1933. This document appears to have been issued
by the Communist Party.

"NOTICE

"A Reply to the Water & Electricity Labour Union

"Fellow Workmen:

"At the needy end of Chinese year the Labour
Union has issued repeated notices calling for the payment of
Union fees. In addition to one day's pay as a special contri-
bution, it asks for another day's pay. We would not make any
objection if we could obtain twelve months' wages in full
each year, but owing to the fact that the Committee of the
Labour Union sold the "strike", we have only obtained ten
months' wages this year. As it will continue to squeeze us
in this manner, we shall make an investigation into/matter.

"The Labour Union claims to be working under
financial difficulties. A loan of three dollars to each
workman was made, but the Union has collected one day's pay
from each of us. Where do the committee of labour union

以下是一份中文小册子的译文，该小册子于1月30日在江边发电站发现，声称由“上海电力公司工人一心会”发布，日期为1933年1月28日。此文件似乎由共产党发布。

“通知

“答复水电工会

“各位工友：

“在中国农历年底之际，工会多次发布通知催缴会费。除要求缴纳一天工资作为特别捐款外，还要求再缴纳一天工资。如果我们每年能拿足十二个月的工资，我们不会有任何异议，但由于工会委员会出卖了‘罢工’，我们今年只拿到了十个月的工资。既然他们继续以这种方式压榨我们，我们将对此事进行调查。

“工会声称面临财政困难。曾向每位工人发放了三美元贷款，但工会却从我们每个人那里收取了一天工资。工会委员会

page_data.en:
- 2 -

spend our money? They should not charge their expenses on
us for riding motorcars, dining in foreign style, visiting
brothels and entertaining the Head of the Loafers (Tu Yush
Sung ?).

"The Labour Union said that "it had secured
many benefits for the whole body of its members" we have,
however, given this question our careful consideration and find
that the assistance given us by the Labour Union was as follows :
1. To forbid the shift workmen from participating in the
strike just in the way our American Capitalist wished them
to, thus crushing our strike.
2. To prevent us from beating the White Russians who spoiled
our strike and insisted upon us feeding our fellow workmen.
3. To prevent us from surrounding the capitalists and drove
us to make appeals to public bodies, as a result none of our
proposals were realized.
4. During the strike two months' wages were deducted and
altogether 54 workmen were dismissed.
5. In order to ensure the return of the three dollars advanced
to each of us, and to collect our union subscription to the
Committee of one day's pay, they stated that the Head of
the Loafers Tu Yush-sung would guarantee that the one month's
wages advanced to us by the Company would not be deducted.
However, the money advanced to Yang Huai-sung has been
deducted, and our receipts, to which our finger prints have
been affixed, are still in the hands of the American
Capitalist.
6. The repeated demands made to us to pay a subscription of
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

把钱花到哪里去了？他们不该把坐汽车、吃西餐、逛妓院以及宴请‘流氓头子’（杜月笙？）的费用摊派到我们头上。

“工会说‘它为全体会员争取了许多利益’，然而，经过仔细考量，我们发现工会给予我们的‘帮助’如下：
1. 禁止轮班工人参与罢工，这正合美国资本家的意愿，从而扼杀了我们的罢工。
2. 阻止我们殴打破坏罢工的白俄，并坚持要求我们供养工友。
3. 阻止我们包围资本家，迫使我们向公共团体请愿，结果我们的提议均未实现。
4. 罢工期间扣除了两个月工资，共有54名工人被解雇。
5. 为了确保退还预支给我们的三美元，并向委员会收取相当于一天工资的会费，他们声称‘流氓头子’杜月笙将保证公司预支给我们的一个月工资不会被扣除。然而，杨怀松（Yang Huai-sung，音译）预支的钱已被扣除，且按有我们指纹的收据仍在美国资本家手中。
6. 反复要求我们缴纳相当于

page_data.en:
- 3 -
one day's pay is the last benefit secured for us by the
honourable Union.
The Union is in a way like the Yamen (official organ) or the
judicial court, and we, workmen, the accused or prisoners.
When the Union decides that it needs money, we must make
payment, should it decide that we have to die, we will have
to die. Is it right that the Union should have directed us
not to beat the White Russians, to obey and to yield to the
Capitalist, and to forfeit our pensions? It was indeed
ridiculous.
"The Labour Union considers that failure to pay
subscriptions fee means "irrationality". The Committee of
the Labour Union, feeling unable to pass the needy end of this
year, comes to squeeze us. But we have old and young family
members who are suffering hunger and cold; who will come to
render us assistance. The Labour Committee are clever but
we are silly creatures. Damned! Whence did you come ?
"We do not consider we have committed a breach of
the law so and far we don't know why we should be punished.
The speech of the Committee of the Labour Union is equivalent
to a scared decree whereas the lives of all our workmen are
not even to be ranked with animals. We are subject to their
managing and slaughtering ! Such is the penalty we purchased with
our subscription fee and such is the prestige of the Committee
of the Labour Union, which is supposed to give us protections.
"Our fellow workmen! We are all betrayed, this
will no longer be tolerable ! We work for one year but receive
but eleven months' wages. In addition to this we have been
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
一天工资的会费，这就是尊贵的工会为我们争取到的最后‘利益’。
工会在某种程度上就像衙门（官方机构）或法庭，而我们工人则是被告或囚犯。当工会决定需要钱时，我们必须付款；若决定让我们死，我们就得死。工会指示我们不殴打白俄、服从并屈服于资本家、并放弃我们的养老金，这样做对吗？这真是荒谬至极。
“工会认为不缴纳会费意味着‘不讲理’。工会委员会感到无法度过今年的难关，便来压榨我们。但我们有老幼家人遭受饥寒，谁会来援助我们呢？工会委员们很聪明，而我们是愚蠢的生物。该死的！你们是从哪里来的？
“我们认为自己并未违法，到目前为止也不知道为何要受惩罚。工会委员会的讲话如同圣旨，而我们所有工人的生命甚至不如牲畜。我们受制于他们的管理和宰割！这就是我们用会费买来的惩罚，这就是 supposedly 保护我们的工会委员会的威望。
“各位工友！我们都背叛了，这再也无法容忍！我们工作一年，却只拿到十一个月的工资。此外，我们还被

page_data.en:
- 4 -
ordered to pay one day's pay in each month. 54 of our fellow
workmen have been discharged with no success attained in
connection with the conditions under dispute. The year is
nearly ended and the Committee of the Labour Union who are
greatly in need of money to spend during the new year, and to
present gifts to the Head of the Loafers - the so called -
Tu Yueh-sung, have repeatedly squeezed us for our one day's
pay. Their notice of October 24 has plainly indicated to
us that as soon as they have collected full amount of the
special contribution, they will again ask from us one days
pay supposedly due in December last. Their falsehood and graft
have been witnessed by us and will no longer be hidden from our
eyes, although we have heretofore been considered as ignorant
fellows.
"We can hardly maintain our standard of living,
but are still expected to pay our regular subscription fees,
as a matter of fact, we will find it difficult to meet our
expenses during the new year with a half month or even one
month's bonus. Yet there is a way out, why not request the
management to give us a half month's bonus in addition to what
we will receive. As to the severe punishment of the honourable
labour union, they are kidnapping, murdering and associating
clandestinely with the capitalists so to encompass our wholesale
dismissal. For instance, prior to the strike coming to a head,
three of our fellow workers were kidnapped and after which 54
more of them were dismissed.
"We are not breathless bodies ! We must rise
up and adhere together at once with a view to strongly opposing
page_data.zh:
- 4 -
命令每月缴纳一天工资作为会费。我们的54位工友被解雇，而在争议条件方面未取得任何成果。年关将近，急需资金过年并向所谓的‘流氓头子’——杜月笙送礼的工会委员会，反复压榨我们要那一日工资的捐款。他们10月24日的通知已明确向我们表示，一旦收齐特别捐款全额，他们将再次向我们索取 supposedly 去年十二月应付的一日工资。他们的谎言和贪腐已被我们目睹，不再能瞒过我们的眼睛，尽管我们此前被视为无知之辈。
“我们难以维持生活水平，但仍被要求缴纳常规会费，事实上，即便有半个月甚至一个月的奖金，我们也难以应付新年的开销。然而有一条出路，何不要求管理层在我们将收到的奖金之外，再给我们半个月的奖金。至于尊贵工会的严厉惩罚，他们是绑架、谋杀并与资本家秘密勾结，以便大规模解雇我们。例如，在罢工达到高潮之前，我们的三位工友被绑架，随后又有54人被解雇。
“我们不是任人摆布的尸体！我们必须立即团结起来，坚决反对

page_data.en:
- 5 -

the Fascistic ambitions of the honourable Labour Union.
The One-minded Association of
the Workmen of S.P.C.
January 26, 1934"

Infor-
mation
obtained
by Agent 56.
Enquiries at the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union, 15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong Road, Chapei, fail to
confirm the report contained in the French Police Daily
Intelligence Summary dated January 29 of a meeting supposedly
held on January 28. A regular meeting of the committee
members was held between 3 p.m. and 4.15 p.m. Saturday, Jan.27,
and was attended by 14 persons. During this meeting,
discussion was held on the increase in allowances granted by
the Union to ex-workers of the Company who are serving with
the Union, but no decision was reached.

Observations at the Union show that the ex-workers of
the Company who practically handle all affairs of the Union
are expecting that the Company will deduct the wages of the
workers for the refunding of the loan granted by the Company
at the close of the recent strike, whereby the Union will
obtain $48,000 from Tu Yush-sung; thus extricating □□□ and the
ex-workers from their financial difficulties.

由56号探员
获得的情报。
在闸北天通路寿英坊15号第四区水电工会进行的查询，未能证实法国警察每日情报摘要（1月29日刊）中关于据称于1月28日举行的一次会议的报道。委员会成员于1月27日星期六下午3时至4时15分举行了一次例行会议，共有14人出席。在这次会议上，讨论了增加工会给予在公司服务的前雇员的津贴事宜，但未作出决定。

对工会的观察显示，实际上处理工会所有事务的公司前雇员正期待公司从工人工资中扣除款项，以偿还公司在最近罢工结束时提供的贷款，从而使工会能够从杜月笙处获得48,000美元；以此解脱□□□及前雇员们的财务困境。

由CDS156、
56号探员及
钱明贤（Chien Minghsien，音译）
获得的情报。
约20名自称代表上海电力公司各部门工人的中国人，于2月3日下午在闸北天通路寿英坊15号第四区水电工会办公室举行会议。前雇员侯洪松（Hau Hung-sung，音译）主持了会议。讨论并通过了以下决议：

page_data.en:
- 6 -
presided. The following resolutions were discussed and
passed :-
1. That owing to the inability of the union to pay off bills
for advertisement and propaganda expenses during the recent
strike, the sectional chiefs of the Union be notified to
collect from each worker a day's wages.
2. That the new committee members elected be urged to assume
office without delay.
3. That the workers be informed of a letter from Tu Yueh-sung
received by the Union on February 1 which states that
deductions will not be made from workers' wages to refund
the loan granted by the Company, and assures the Union that
he will be responsible for the payment should the Company
eventually enforce the deduction.
4. That a membership fee of $0.20 each be collected from
members when they are issued with double wages at the
"Lunar New Year", February 10.
5. That funds be raised from amongst the members for the
relief of some 20 ex-workers who are still unemployed.

obtained

Company dismissed in the recent strike obtained sums ranging
from $5 to $10 as relief money from the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union. A total of $90.00 was issued.
Attached will be found two appendices, A) being a statement
of accounts of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union for December, 1933 and B) being a list of subscriptions
collected from workers.
D. S. I.

2. 敦促新当选的委员会成员立即就职。
3. 告知工人，工会于2月1日收到杜月笙的一封信，信中声明不会从工人工资中扣款以偿还公司提供的贷款，并保证如果公司最终强制执行扣款，他将负责支付。
4. 在2月10日“农历新年”发放双薪时，向会员每人收取0.20美元的会费。
5. 在会员中筹集资金，以救济约20名仍失业的前雇员。

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY. No. D-318/1 Date 7 Feb 1934）
Date February 5, 1934.
Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Notices issued by workers - notice posted by Company.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by W Duncan A.S.D.

For reasons which the Company have so far refused to divulge, the loan of one month's pay granted to workers at the end of the last strike and which was to have been collected at the rate of 10% per month as from February 28, will not be collected until and commencing from July, 1934. The management have caused notices to this effect to be posted in their various plants.

The following is a translation of a pamphlet in Chinese found in the Riverside Power Station on January 30 and purporting to have been issued by the "One-minded Association of the Workmen of the Shanghai Power Company" and dated January 26, 1933. This document appears to have been issued by the Communist Party.

"NOTICE
"A Reply to the Water & Electricity Labour Union
"Fellow Workmen:
"At the needy end of Chinese year the Labour Union has issued repeated notices calling for the payment of Union fees. In addition to one day's pay as a special contribution, it asks for another day's pay. We would not make any objection if we could obtain twelve months' wages in full each year, but owing to the fact that the Committee of the Labour Union sold the "strike", we have only obtained ten months' wages this year. As it will continue to squeeze us in this manner, we shall make an investigation into the matter.
"The Labour Union claims to be working under financial difficulties. A loan of three dollars to each workmen was made, but the Union has collected one day's pay from each of us. Where do the committee of labour union

The Union is in a way like the Yamen (official organ) or the

the Labour Union, feeling unable to pass the needy end of this
year, comes to squeeze us. But we have old and young family

render us assistance? The Labour Committee are clever but

"We do not consider we have committed a breach of

menacing and slaughtering ! Such is the penalty we purchased with

当工会决定需要钱时，我们就必须付款；如果它决定我们必须死，我们就得去死。工会指示我们不要殴打白俄，要顺从并向资本家屈服，还要 forfeit（放弃/丧失）我们的养老金，这难道是正确的吗？这确实荒谬可笑。

“我们不认为我们违反了法律，因此至今不知道为何要受惩罚。工会委员会的讲话等同于一道可怕的法令，而我们所有工人的生命甚至不如牲畜。我们受制于他们的威胁和屠杀！这就是我们用会费换来的惩罚，也是 supposedly（号称）给予我们保护的工会委员会的威望。

Enquiries at the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union, 15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong Road, Chapei, fail to
confirm the report contained in the French Police Daily
Intelligence Summary dated January 29 of a meeting supposedly
held on January 28. A regular meeting of the committee
members was held between 3 p.m. and 4.15 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 27,
and was attended by 14 persons. During this meeting,
discussion was held on the increase in allowances granted by
the Union to ex-workers of the Company who are serving with
the Union, but no decision was reached.
Observations at the Union show that the ex-workers of
the Company who practically handle all affairs of the Union
are expecting that the Company will deduct the wages of the
workers for the refunding of the loan granted by the Company
at the close of the recent strike, whereby the Union will
obtain $48,000 from Tu Yueh-sung, thus extricating it and the
ex-workers from their financial difficulties.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310/1
S.I, Special Branch XXXXX /......
January 19, 34.

Shanghai Power Company - workers' Union issues
notification.

D.S.I. Golder

The following is a translation of a pamphlet
chopped by the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union and dated January 15, 1934 :-

Notification of the 4th District Water
and Electricity Workers' Union

The Union has been in financial difficulties since
the recent labour dispute. Some time ago, a special
subscription equal to one day's wages was collected from the
workers but, the proceeds were far from sufficient to cover
the expenses. The Lunar New Year draws nearer and various
expenditure such as rent, staff pay, etc. has to be defrayed.
The treasury of the Union is empty. The committee of the
Union has resolved that the membership fees for December,
1933 be collected at the end of the current month or on the
next payday, meanwhile all subscriptions outstanding should
be paid so that the Union can carry on its activities
which concern the welfare of the whole body of workers.
As various members are enthusiastically supporting the Union,
the Union expects that they will pay fees when due and will
not hesitate in doing so.

The formation and establishment of the Union have
been completed, but if the fees of the members remain unpaid
there is every possibility that the body will be forced
to dissolve, in that case the members will be left unprotected
and will be subjected to further oppression.

With regard to the loan of one months pay advanced
by the Company at the end of the last strike, Tu Yueh-sung,
the mediator, has sincerely promised that should the Company
insist on deducting the loan, the workers will not suffer

1934年1月19日。

上海电力公司 - 工会问题
通知。

特别巡官 Golder

以下是由第四区水电工人工会盖章并
注明日期为1934年1月15日的传单译文：-

第四区水电工人工会通知

自最近的劳资纠纷以来，工会一直面临财政困难。前
段时间，向工人募集了相当于一天工资的特殊捐款，但
所得款项远不足以支付开支。农历新年临近，必须支付
租金、职员薪水等各种费用。工会金库已空。工会委员
会决议，于本月底或下一个发薪日收取1933年12月的
会费，同时应缴清所有未付捐款，以便工会能够继续开
展关乎全体工人福利的活动。鉴于各位会员热情支持工
会，工会期望他们能按时缴纳会费，不要犹豫。

工会的组建和成立工作已经完成，但如果会员费
用仍未缴纳，该组织极有可能被迫解散，在这种情况下，
会员将失去保护，并遭受进一步的压迫。

关于上次罢工结束时由公司垫付的一个月工资贷
款一事，调解人涂月生 (Tu Yueh-sung) 曾诚恳承诺，
如果公司坚持扣除该笔贷款，工人不会遭受

page_data.en:
- 2 -

for the sum will be made good to them. Members are
requested not to worry.

It is generally reported that approximately 50%
of the workers of the Shanghai Power Company have failed to
pay their membership fees to the Union for the past two
months, and that the remainder are not too willing to pay,
but do so under pressure.

With the exception of the protracted agitation
on the part of 18 dismissed clerks for the payment of
retiring gratuities, which is not receiving the support of
the General Labour Union, affairs with the Company are
very quiet.

D. J. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch,
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

损失，因为这笔款项将由他补偿给工人。请会员们
不必担心。

据普遍报告，上海电力公司约50%的工人在过
去两个月内未向工会缴纳会费，其余的人也不太愿意
缴纳，只是在压力下才缴纳。

除了18名被解雇的职员为索取遣散费而进行的
长期 agitation（煽动/活动），且该活动未得到总工会
的支持外，与公司有关的事务非常平静。

特别股主管警官

D. J. I.

Special Branch. D XXXX

REPORT
Date January 22. / 19 34.

Subject (in full) China General Omnibus Company - Conductors Union :
holds meeting.

Made by D. S. I. Golder. Forwarded by Whouman DSJ

Some ten members of the China General
Omnibus Company Conductors Self Improvement Control Union
held a meeting in their offices, No 1171 Connaught Road
between 8 and 10 p.m. on January 19 when the following
resolutions were passed.

(1) That a school for the benefit of the conductors
be established in the union offices and commence
classes from January 22. 1934.

(2) That Yu Zu-sung (俞樹森) student of the Kwang
Hwa University be engaged as a teacher and that the
fees for tuition be fixed at 50 cents per month
per man

(3) That in order to avoid any misunderstanding arising
as the result of conductors riding on buses in plain
clothes when off duty, they be issued with passes
prepared by the union and countersigned by the
Management.

(4) That all conductors be instructed to submit two
copies of a photograph, to be of passport size,
for the purpose of affixing to their passes. Further
such passes should only be issued to conductors
when their union fees have been paid in full.

So far the Management have not been approached regarding the
passes and it is doubtful if they will consent to the use
of them as it would in all probability lead to corruption.
It might be pointed out that the conductors could sell such
passes at the same rate as season tickets and thus defraud
the Company of considerable revenue..

Officer i/c Special Branch
D. S. I.
Em Golder

主题（全称）中国公共汽车公司 - 售票员公会：
举行会议。

由特别巡官 Golder 撰写。由副督察长 Whouman 转呈

中国公共汽车公司售票员自强控制公会
的约十名成员于1月19日晚8点至10点之间，在康纳
路1171号的公会办公室举行会议，会上通过了以下决
议。

(1) 在公会办公室设立一所惠及售票员的学校，
并于1934年1月22日开始上课。

(2) 聘请光华大学学生俞树森 (Yu Zu-sung) 担任
教师，学费定为每人每月50分。

(3) 为避免因售票员下班后便衣乘坐公交车而引
起任何误解，向他们发放由公会制备并经管理
层副署的通行证。

(4) 指示所有售票员提交两张护照尺寸的照片，
用于贴在通行证上。此外，此类通行证仅在售
票员缴清公会会费后方可发放。

截至目前，尚未就通行证一事与管理层接洽，且他们
是否同意使用这些通行证尚存疑问，因为这很可能会导致
腐败。不妨指出，售票员可能会以与月票相同的价格出
售此类通行证，从而骗取公司大量收入。。

特别股主管警官
特别巡官
Em Golder

（左侧批注：此人在巴士公司工人罢工期间领导了煽动活动。JR）

The workers of the Riverside Power Station
were paid on January 19. Meanwhile the majority of
them paid to the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union through various foremen one day's wages as a part
of payment of membership fees in arrears.

The payment of the Union fees in arrears by
the majority of members appears to be a reversion of the
attitude previously and recently displayed by them regarding
the Union. Careful note will be kept of events between
now and February 28 (the date on which the first deduction
from wages in repayment of the loan granted by the
Company will be made) so as to determine whether
intimidation is still rife.

D. S. I.

Date January 19, 1934.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - workers' Union issues
notification.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Wouman ASD

The following is a translation of a pamphlet
chopped by the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union and dated January 15, 1934 :-

Notification of the 4th District Water
and Electricity Workers' Union

The Union has been in financial difficulties since
the recent labour dispute. Some time ago, a special
subscription equal to one day's wages was collected from the
workers but the proceeds were far from sufficient to cover
the expenses. The Lunar New Year draws nearer and various
expenditure such as rent, staff pay, etc. has to be defrayed.
The treasury of the Union is empty. The committee of the
Union has resolved that the membership fees for December,
1933 be collected at the end of the current month or on the
next payday, meanwhile all subscriptions outstanding should
be paid so that the Union can carry on its activities
which concern the welfare of the whole body of workers.
As various members are enthusiastically supporting the Union,
the Union expects that they will pay fees when due and will
not hesitate in doing so.

The formation and establishment of the Union have
been completed, but if the fees of the members remain unpaid
there is every possibility that the body will be forced
to dissolve, in that case the members will be left unprotected
and will be subjected to further oppression.

With regard to the loan of one months pay advanced
by the Company at the end of the last strike, Tu Yueh-sung,
the mediator, has sincerely promised that should the Company
insist on deducting the loan, the workers will not suffer

会决议，于本月底或下一个发薪日收取1933年12月的
会费，同时应缴清所有未付捐款，以便工会能够继续开
展关乎全体工人福利的活动。鉴于各位会员热情支持工
会，工会期望他们能按时缴纳会费，不要犹豫。

工会的组建和成立工作已经完成，但如果会员费

Shanghai Power Company - Workers' Union presents
silver cup to Tu Yueh Sung.
D.S.I. Golder

Hsu Hung Sung (徐洪生), Pan Keng Ling (潘根林),
Yang Shao Kung (杨少公) and Chu Hao Sung (朱浩松)
representing the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union, called on Tu Yueh Sung (杜月笙) at his
residence, 216 Rue Wagner, at 3 p.m. January 8 and
presented him on behalf of the Union with a silver
cup valued at about $130.00 as a token of their
appreciation for his bringing about a settlement of the
Shanghai Power Company strike. In response to a
request of the Union delegates, Tu Yueh Sung promised
to request the Management not to carry out its intention
of deducting 10% of the workers wages, commencing from
February 28 in repayment of the loan granted them at
the conclusion of the recent strike. Tu also stated
that should the management refuse to entertain the
request, he would refund the workers' loan out of his own
pocket.

D. S. I.

Shanghai Power Company caused to be posted in the various
premises notices in English and Chinese which read as follows :
"The management of the Shanghai Power Company reserve
the right to employ whomsoever they desire and any workmen
found interfering, in anyway, with persons engaged through

plant, will be instantly dismissed, and will forfeit all
rights to whatsoever retiring gratuity and/or bonus he may
have been in expectation of."

part of the management to abolish the (No.1 System) which

On Saturday, December 16, a male Chinese
accompanied by a delegate of Loh Ching-dz (陸京士),
prominent member of the local Kuomintang, proceeded to
the offices of the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union. The person, whose name was not obtained
was in search of work with the Shanghai Power Company
and was persuaded to go to the Union first. No promise
of assistance was made, but the man was given a copy of a handbill
which translated reads as follows :-

"Notification No. ____ of the 4th District
Water & Electricity Workers' Union.

"During the recent "tai-kung" strike of the workers,
"the Shanghai Power Company dismissed a large number of old
"hands who had many years' service with the Company. More
"recently due to are press of work at Riverside the management
"have recruited new hands. Fortunately the workers of the
"various departments realize the advantage to the Company
"to employ new hands. The workers have been successful
"in preventing the new hands from starting work. As this
"matter concerns the personal welfare of the workers, this
"Union held a committee meeting on December 14 and passed
"the following resolution :

"No new hands should enter the service of the Company
"until after the workers' demand and the question of the
"one month's pay have been settled. The workers of various
"shops and departments must always pay attention to this
"matter so that no new operatives will be taken into the
"service of the Company.

"This union specially asks you to note the above-

Date December 12, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by Whouman, ASP.

Mr. Heald, General Manager of the Shanghai Power
Company, during an interview on Tuesday, December 12, stated
that further attempts had been made by old workers to
intimidate new hands set on by the Management.

It might be explained that the Shanghai Municipal
Electric Department and later the Shanghai Power Company
employed new hands through their No.1 Chinese. This is
considered a most undesirable system in big concerns as
it leads to cliques forming and opens up channels for
"squeeze" by the No.1 who trades upon the fact that those
working under him are there on his recommendation. The
Shanghai Power Company realize this and are determined to
stamp it out. Their first step was to take the employment
of new hands from the No.1's. This move has aroused the
anger of the individuals whose perquisites will be greatly
reduced and they have obtained the assistance of workers to
intimidate the new hands unless such are employed in the
custom honoured method.

Mr. Heald declared that the Company were prepared
to declare a lockout, other methods failing, and to employ
new hands gradually.

Discreet enquiries are being made into the facts
of the case to determine how far the present situation is
likely to develope.

（批：Info 13/12. Filed J.Hg DEC. 14）
Copy sent to DO "D"
J.R.
Eric Golder
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期 1933年12月12日。

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 局势

由特别调查督察戈尔德（Golder）撰写。由助理副巡官 Whouman 转呈。

上海电力公司总经理希尔德（Heald）先生在12月12日星期二的会谈中表示，老员工再次试图恐吓管理层雇佣的新手。

需要说明的是，上海工部局电气处及后来的上海电力公司均通过其“华籍领班”（No.1 Chinese）雇佣新手。在大型企业中，这被认为是一种极不可取的制度，因为它会导致派系形成，并为“华籍领班”利用其下属系由其推荐这一事实进行“勒索”（squeeze）打开渠道。上海电力公司认识到这一点，并决心根除这一弊病。他们的第一步是从“华籍领班”手中收回雇佣新手的权力。此举激怒了那些额外收入将大幅减少的个人，他们已寻求工人的帮助，以恐吓新手，除非按惯例认可的方式雇佣这些新手。

希尔德先生宣称，如果其他方法失败，公司准备宣布停工（lockout），并逐步雇佣新手。

正在对案件事实进行谨慎调查，以确定当前局势可能发展到何种程度。

（批注：阅知 12/13。归档 J.Hg 12月14日）

At 10.30 a.m. December 9 Fang Chien and Tung
Tien Kong (董天元), two ex-employees of the Shanghai
Power Company and representing the Unemployed Staff
Appeal Committee visited the offices of the General
Labour Union where they appealed for assistance.
In outlining their case to Chu Hsueh Fang (朱学范),
committee member of the General Labour Union, the callers
claimed that they had been completely left out of the
terms of the settlement of the recent labour dispute.
They asked that the matter of retiring gratuities for
the 18 dismissed clerical employees be taken up with the
mediations. Chu refused to consider the matter and
referred his visitors to the Company for relief. Before
leaving Fang Chien and Tung Tien Kong denounced Chu as
a traitor and claimed that the persons whom they
represented had been betrayed.

Six members of the "Shanghai Power Company
Unemployed Staff Appeal Committee" organized by the
18 ex-clerks dismissed during the recent strike held a
meeting in the residence of Kao Wen Ching (高文慶), a
clerk in the employ of the Shanghai Power Company, 84
Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate, between 2.30 and 3 p.m.
December 10. Fang Chien presided over the meeting.

1. That representations be made to Tu Yueh Sung on December
11 with a view to obtaining his assistance in the matter
of the demand of the ex-clerks for the issue of gratuities
2. That Chu Hsueh Fan of the General Labour Union be asked
by letter to give an explanation of his attitude when

Shanghai Power Company - ex-clerks agitate
for Gratuities.

D. S. I. Golder

Information
obtained by
Agent No.59

Four representatives of the eighteen ex-clerks
of the Shanghai Power Company who were dismissed in the
recent strike, called on Tu Yueh-sung at his residence
at 216 Rue Wagner at 11 a.m. December 8 and requested
assistance in their demand for either gratuities to them
or their reinstatement. Tu Yueh-sung, however, refused
to entertain the request.

These representatives visited the General Labour
Union, 117 Foh You Road, City, at 2 p.m. the same day
for the same purpose but without avail.

Eight members of the "Shanghai Power Company
Unemployed Staff Calling-for-Help Committee" organized
by the 18 ex-clerks held a meeting in the residence of
one of their number, 84 Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate,
between 3.30 p.m. and 5 p.m. December 8. The following
resolutions were discussed and passed :-

1. That representations be made to the local Kuomintang,
Bureau of Social Affairs and the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai for assistance.

2. That the assistance of the Chinese press be also
requested in the matter.

3. That the Central Kuomintang and the Ministry of Industry
be requested to instruct the local Chinese Authorities
to render every possible assistance to the ex-clerks
and to conduct negotiations with the Shanghai Power
Company in their favour.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.
Made by. D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by W. Lounean DSS

As mentioned in my reports dealing with the
labour difficulties of the above company, it is the
management's intention to introduce natives of the
Northern Provinces to replace the radical elements
among their workers, now causing them so much anxiety.
It was decided that the change over should be
gradual and to this end the management have taken the
job of hiring labour out of the hands of their No.1
Chinese (gangers) (foremen) and placed it under the
supervision of the foreigners in charge of departments.
This innovation has caused a certain amount of
disaffection among the workers who take it upon them-
selves to warn new hands employed through the various
foreigners, that it would be safer for them not to start
work unless they are first "approved" of by the Union.
During the past two days definite cases of verbal threats
have been brought to the notice of Mr. Webb, Chief
Engineer.
During an interview with Mr. Webb on December 4,
it was learned that in one case which occurred at
Riverside Power Station a man was tested as to his
ability and subsequently set to work. At the noon meal
hour, the man left the premises and was informed by a
number of workers that drastic action would be taken
if he insisted on holding his job.
The management's view of the matter is that it
is serious and must be eradicated immediately. They
take the stand that as the operators of the Company
they must be in a position to hire the labour they

在12月4日与 Webb 先生的面谈中获悉，在江边发电厂发生的一起案件中，一名男子经过能力测试后随即上岗。在午餐时间，该男子离开工厂，并被告知多名工人称，如果他坚持保住这份工作，将会采取严厉行动。

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by W.Houcan DSD

Information obtained by Agents 50 & 51.

The situation in the Shanghai Power Company remains normal this morning.

With reference to my report of November 23, 1933, the meeting arranged by the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union was held in the office of the 1st District Water & Electricity Workers' Union, Kuo Hu Road, Nantao, at 3.15 p.m. November 25 when some 700 persons were present. Pan Keng-ling (潘林), one of the workers present, presided and explained that the meeting had been convened to discuss the question of electing new members to the Union Committee to replace those who had been dismissed from the Company's employ.. Other speakers included Tai Yeu-heng (戴有恒), representing the local Kuomintang, Chow Hsueh-siang (周學湘), representing the General Labour Union, and Chu Hsueh-fan (朱學範), all praised the united spirit of the workers during the last strike and encouraged them to continue their fight against the "alleged" imperialists' oppression. The last speaker also declared that relief measures should also be devised for the dismissed workers who had sacrificed their positions for the welfare of all workers. The following resolutions were then discussed and passed :-

1. That eight workers be entrusted with the task of convening a general meeting for the purpose of electing a new committee.

2. That all workers contribute one day's wages for the relief of the dismissed workers.

3. That the fund advanced by the General Labour Union be paid Back by the workers when they have drawn their pay.

今晨上海电力公司的局势保持正常。

参照我1933年11月23日的报告，由第四区水电工会安排的会议于11月25日下午3时15分在南市国货路第一区水电工会办公室举行，约有700人出席。与会工人之一的潘林（Pan Keng-ling）主持了会议，并解释说召开会议是为了讨论选举新的工会委员会成员以取代那些被公司解雇的成员的问题。其他发言者包括代表当地国民党的戴有恒（Tai Yeu-heng）、代表总工会的周学湘（Chow Hsueh-siang）和朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan），他们都赞扬了工人在上次罢工期间的团结精神，并鼓励他们继续对抗“所谓”的帝国主义压迫。最后一位发言人还宣布，应为那些为了全体工人的福利而牺牲职位的被解雇工人制定救济措施。随后讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 委托八名工人负责召集全体会议，目的是选举新的委员会。

2. 所有工人捐献一天工资，用于救济被解雇的工人。

3. 总工会垫付的资金，由工人们在领取工资后偿还。

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Whouman D.S.I.

The situation in the Shanghai Power Company is normal this morning.

With reference to the loan offered by the management of the Shanghai Power Company to those of its Chinese employees who have recently been on strike. All those affected have asked to be permitted to take up the loan and have signed an acknowledgement, they have, however, refused to affix their thumbprint to the document on the ground that they consider it somewhat degrading to be treated as criminals.

There still exists a certain amount of doubt as to how the Company are going to encompass the repayment of the loan. In this connection it is reported that Yu Yah-ching in compliance with a request of the workers has offered to repay the Company within two weeks on condition that the personal receipts of the workers are destroyed.

Information obtained by Agent No.51
The 4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union, 15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong Road, Chapel, is arranging to convene a general meeting of its members in the 1st District Water and Electricity Workers' Union, Kuo llu Road, Nantao, at 2 p.m. November 25. Copies of a notice to this effect will be distributed among the workers on November 23. It is learned that the chief object of this meeting is to elect staff members of the Union from amongst the 56 men dismissed by the Management as the result of the strike. It is also learned that the General Labour Union is arranging to find work for those who are not elected to the Union in electricity plants in Wusieh and other inland places.

Copies of a notice, of which the following is a translation, will be issued on November 23 by the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union to the foremen of the Shanghai Power Company who are members of the Union :

"During the strike, the General Labour Union lent us considerable sums of money to assist us to maintain our members. As work has been resumed, it is necessary to refund the money and keep faith with the General Labour Union. Besides the repayment of "maintenance loans", each worker must contribute a day's wages.

"You are hereby requested to forward the aforementioned monies to this Union within three days. You will be held responsible for the collection of the funds from all workers under your supervision. This is a matter of public service, you are expected to comply immediately."

Officer i/c Special Branch.

位于天潼路教堂（Chapel）寿英坊15号的第四区水电工会，正安排于11月25日下午2时，在南市国货路（Kuo llu Road）第一区水电工会召开会员大会。有关此事项的通知副本将于11月23日向工人们分发。据悉，此次会议的主要目的是从资方因罢工而解雇的56名工人中选举工会职员。另悉，总工会正安排为那些未能当选进入工会的人员，在吴淞（Wusieh）及其他内地地方的发电厂寻找工作。

第四区水电工会将于11月23日向身为该工会成员的上海电力公司领班发出通知副本，译文如下：

“在罢工期间，总工会借给我们巨额款项，以协助我们维持会员生活。既然已复工，有必要偿还这笔钱，以对总工会信守承诺。除了偿还‘维持费贷款’外，每名工人还需捐献一天工资。

现请你们在三天内将上述款项交至本工会。你们须负责向所有受你们监督的工人收取这笔资金。这是公益事务，望你们立即遵照执行。”

REPORT
Date November 14, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Wouman A.S.S.

The situation in the various departments of
the Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
Some 1,200 Chinese and 320 Russians are working
on a normal basis in all departments with the exception
of certain cable installation which the Company claim to
be able to hold up for a month or so without causing any
inconvenience to consumers.
Despite the notices posted by the Company on its
various premises setting forth that no further vacancies
exist for workmen, applications for jobs continue to be
made.
Mr. Heald, General Manager of the Company, has
informed the undersigned that the Company intend to
continue operations along the present lines and to ignore
all representation of the Union/
The Management are of the opinion that the more
conservative of the employees and workers will eventually
see that they have been duped into going on strike and as
they represent about 80% of the whole, the matter will
ultimately right itself.

Em Golder
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch. Reg 1500/16/11.

Commr. of Police.
Sir:
Information.
J. Simmons
O. i/c S. B.

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。
除某些电缆安装工程外（公司声称可以暂停一个月左右而不会给消费者带来任何不便），所有部门约有1,200名华人和320名俄国人正常工作。
尽管公司在其各处张贴告示，声明不再招收工人，但仍有人继续申请工作。
公司总经理 Heald 先生告知签署人，公司打算按现状继续运营，并无视工会的所有交涉代表。
管理层认为，员工和工人中较为保守的部分最终会意识到他们是被欺骗去罢工的，由于这部分人约占总数80%，事态最终会自行纠正。

Date November 8, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Whunson

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.

Of the 300 men who presented themselves at
Riverside Power Station on November 7 seeking employment
in the places of those on strike, 24 were examined as to
their ability, thus bringing the total of possible new
hands up to 233.

The 50 who were at Fearon Road (Vide my report
dated November 7) were found to be unsuitable and therefore
were told not to return.

At 1 p.m. November 7, a Eurasian named James
Muller of no fixed abode, who claims to be a British
subject was returning from the Riverside Power Station
where he had applied for work and when opposite the old
Sung Sing No.9 Cotton Mill on Yangtszepoo Road was set
upon by a strike picket group of about 20 men. The
man's assailants beat and stabbed him and decamped upon
the approach of the police. Muller was sent to the
Sacred Heart Hospital where he was found to suffering
from contusions, abrasion and a number of small punctured
wounds in the back. His condition was not serious and
he was not detained. Yangtszepoo Station Detectives are
enquiring into the case.

The three men taken into custody by Yangtszepoo
Station on November 6 for intimidation were all arraigned
before the 1st Special District Court on November 7 when
they were fined each $20.00.

Attached will be found a copy of the regulations
governing service with the Shanghai Power Company as

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。

11月7日，有300人来到江边发电站，寻求受雇以替代罢工者，其中24人接受了能力考核，从而使可能的新手总数达到233人。

此前在斐伦路（Fearon Road）的50人（参见我11月7日的报告）被认为不合适，因此被告知不必再来。

11月7日下午1时，一名自称英国臣民、无固定住所的欧亚混血男子 James Muller，在申请工作后从江边发电站返回，当行至杨树浦路旧松盛第九棉纺厂对面时，遭到约20名罢工纠察队员的袭击。袭击者殴打并刺伤了他，并在警察接近时逃窜。Muller 被送往圣心医院，经查身有多处挫伤、擦伤以及背部多处细小刺穿伤。他的情况并不严重，未被拘留。杨树浦路站侦探正在调查此案。

11月6日因恐吓罪被杨树浦路站逮捕的三名男子，均于11月7日在第一特区法院受审，每人被罚款20.00元。

STAFF ORDER No. 3/1

SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY
REGULAR CHINESE STAFF
SUMMARY OF GENERAL CONDITIONS OF SERVICE AND BENEFITS,
AND INSTRUCTIONS ON VARIOUS MATTERS APPERTAINING TO
CHINESE EMPLOYEES (EXCLUDING LOCAL APPOINTEES).

1. CHINESE PROVIDENT SCHEME:

(a) Spring Holiday bonus: The bonuses stated below will be issued annually
at the Spring Holiday :-

A. To every Chinese employee who has served continuously during the
whole of the preceding twelve months but has not completed ten years'
continuous service - Half of one month's ordinary pay.

B. To every Chinese employee who has completed ten years', or more,
continuous service - One month's ordinary pay.

(b) Funeral expenses and proof of death: On the death of any Chinese
employee a gratuity of $60 will be issued as funeral expenses. This
sum will be paid to the person or persons considered fit and proper to
receive it. This gratuity is payable irrespective of length of service,
but only after proof of death and identification of the employee has been
clearly established. The head of the department concerned must
immediately notify the Chinese Staff Office in the case of the death of
any Chinese employee, giving full particulars of location of the
deceased, etc., whereupon the necessary action will be taken to establish
identity.

(c) Death gratuity: On the death of any Chinese employee a gratuity equal
to five per cent of the monthly ordinary pay drawn by such employee at
the time of his death will be payable in respect of each complete month
of continuous service. This gratuity will be paid to the person or
persons considered fit and proper to receive it, but only after proof of
death and identification of the employee has been clearly established.

职员命令第3/1号

上海电力公司
正式华籍职员
一般服务条件及福利摘要，
以及关于华籍雇员（不包括本地聘用人员）各项事宜的指示。

1. 华籍职员公积金计划：

(a) 春节奖金：下列奖金将于每年春节发放：-

A. 凡在过去十二个月内连续服务，但连续服务未满十年之每一华籍雇员——半个月普通薪金。

B. 凡已完成十年或十年以上连续服务之每一华籍雇员——一个月普通薪金。

(b) 丧葬费及死亡证明：任何华籍雇员身故时，将发放60元作为丧葬费。此款项将支付给被认为适宜接收之人。无论服务年限长短，均可领取此笔抚恤金，但须在明确证实死亡及雇员身份后方可支付。如有华籍雇员身故，相关部门主管必须立即通知华籍职员办公室，提供死者地点等详细情况，随后将采取必要措施以确认身份。

(c) 身故抚恤金：任何华籍雇员身故时，按其身故时所领取的每月普通薪金的百分之五，乘以连续服务的完整月数，计算并发放抚恤金。此抚恤金将支付给被认为适宜接收之人，但须在明确证实死亡及雇员身份后方可支付。

page_data.en:
Sheet 2 of 8 sheets.

(d) Invaliding gratuity: In the event of it being necessary to invalid any
Chinese employee out of the service of the Company, under medical
certificate, he will be entitled to receive a sum equal to five per cent
of the monthly ordinary pay being drawn by him at the date of such
invaliding in respect of each complete month of continuous service, upon
favourable recommendation in each case by the General Manager. The
official date of invaliding shall be one week after the medical
certificate is passed by the General Manager.

(e) Retirement gratuity: The gratuities stated below will be issued on
retirement or discharge :-

1. To every Chinese employee whose services are terminated by the
Company (except for misconduct) after the completion of one year's
continuous service and before the completion of twenty years'
continuous service.

An amount, computed as under noted -

METHOD OF COMPUTATION

(1) One-third of one per cent will be multiplied by the number of
completed years of continuous service.

(2) The percentage produced under (1) but subject to a maximum of
five per cent will be applied to the annual ordinary pay
being drawn by the employee at the date of discharge.

(3) The amount produced under (2) will be multiplied by the period
of continuous service expressed in terms of years to the last
completed month, e.g., 5 years and 7 months = 5-7/12, to
arrive at the gratuity.

(4) Expressed as formulae, the foregoing method of computation is
represented by :-

I. Under fifteen years' continuous service -

      (No. of       )   (          )   (No. of       )
1 x (completed) x (Annual) x (completed)
      (years        )   (pay       )   (months       )    = Gratuity
      -----------------   ----------   -----------------
            3 x 100           12

II. Fifteen years', or more, continuous service -

      (          )   (No. of       )
(Annual) x 5 x (completed)
(pay       )   (months       )    = Gratuity
----------   -----------------
 1 x 100 x 12

第2页，共8页。

(d) 病退抚恤金：如有必要根据医疗证明使任何华籍雇员因病退出公司服务，经总经理在个案中给予有利推荐后，该雇员有权按其病退之日所领取的每月普通薪金的百分之五，乘以连续服务的完整月数，领取一笔款项。正式病退日期为总经理批准医疗证明后的一周。

(e) 退休抚恤金：下列抚恤金将于退休或解雇时发放：-

1. 凡连续服务满一年但未满二十年，且由公司终止服务（非因行为不端）之每一华籍雇员。

金额计算如下 -

计算方法

(1) 将百分之三的三分之一乘以连续服务的完整年数。

(2) 将(1)项得出的百分比（最高不超过百分之五）应用于雇员在解雇之日所领取的年度普通薪金。

(3) 将(2)项得出的金额乘以以年为单位表示的连续服务期（计至最后一个完整月），例如，5年7个月 = 5又7/12，从而得出抚恤金。

(4) 用公式表示，上述计算方法如下：-

I. 连续服务不满十五年 -

      (完整       )   (          )   (完整       )

            3 x 100           12

II. 连续服务十五年或以上 -

      (          )   (完整       )
(年度     ) x 5 x (月数        )    = 抚恤金
(薪金     )   -----------------

 1 x 100 x 12

(5) The minimum gratuity to be two per cent of the annual pay being drawn by the employee at the date of discharge.

Formula:-
(Annual) x 2      (Minimum )
(pay   )          = (Gratuity)
   100

This benefit applies only to men discharged by the Company, and not to men leaving of their own accord, to whom the qualification of twenty years' continuous service stated in B applies.

B. To every Chinese employee on resignation or discharge at any time after the completion of twenty years' continuous service -

An amount equal to five per cent of the monthly ordinary pay being drawn by the employee at the date of leaving the Company's service multiplied by the number of completed months of continuous service.
Formula:- Same as A (4) II.

(f) Injury on duty: In the event of any Chinese employee being killed during the execution of his duty, or whose death or invaliding is due to causes arising directly out of the performance of duty, the "Death" or "Invaliding" gratuity will be the subject of special consideration in each case.

(g) Next-of-kin - particulars required: All members of the Chinese staff are required to provide information regarding their next-of-kin. Any men refusing to supply such information will not be allowed to participate in any of the benefits under the Provident Scheme.

2. DISPENSARIES, MEDICAL TREATMENT, PERIOD OF ABSENCE ALLOWED, PAY DURING SICKNESS, ETC:-

(a) DISPENSARIES

(1) Dispensaries provided: Dispensaries have been established at Riverside and Pearce Road for the purpose of giving medical out-patient treatment to members of the Chinese staff.

(2) Treatment free of charge: Such treatment as that referred to in paragraph (a) will be provided free of charge, subject to the following conditions being observed :-

(3) How to obtain treatment: Application for treatment at a dispensary must be made on the printed form provided by the Company. Before treatment can be given this form must first be signed by the head of the section in which the applicant is engaged, and then presented by the man requiring treatment to the doctor-in-charge.

(4) Where to obtain treatment: No treatment can be given by the Doctor-in-charge of the dispensaries to any of the Chinese staff except on the premises of the Company.
page_data.zh:
第3页，共8页。

(5) 最低抚恤金为雇员在解雇之日所领取年度薪金的百分之二。

公式：-
(年度     ) x 2      (最低     )
(薪金     )          = (抚恤金   )
   100

此项福利仅适用于由公司解雇的人员，不适用于自行离职人员；自行离职人员适用B项中规定的连续服务二十年的资格。

B. 凡在完成二十年连续服务后的任何时候辞职或被解雇之每一华籍雇员 -

金额等于雇员在离开公司服务之日所领取的每月普通薪金的百分之五，乘以连续服务的完整月数。
公式：- 同 A (4) II。

(f) 因公受伤：如有任何华籍雇员在执行职务期间身亡，或其死亡或病退是直接由履行职务引起的，则将针对个案特别考虑“身故”或“病退”抚恤金。

(g) 近亲 - 所需详情：所有华籍职员均需提供其近亲信息。任何拒绝提供此类信息的人员将不得参与公积金计划下的任何福利。

2. 诊疗所、医疗、准假期限、病假薪资等：-

(a) 诊疗所

(1) 设立的诊疗所：已在 Riverside（音译）和 Pearce Road（音译）设立诊疗所，旨在为华籍职员提供门诊医疗服务。

(2) 免费治疗：在遵守以下条件的前提下，第(a)段所述之治疗将免费提供：-

(3) 如何获得治疗：申请在诊疗所接受治疗必须使用公司提供的印刷表格。在治疗开始前，该表格必须先由申请人所在部门的主管签字，然后由需要治疗的人员提交给主治医生。

(4) 何处接受治疗：除非在公司场所内，否则诊疗所主治医生不得向任何华籍职员提供治疗。

If an employee absents himself from duty for a period of more than three
days without first obtaining permission or a medical certificate he will
be treated as having left the service of the Company. If he subsequently
reports for duty he can only recommence as a new man; that is, he will lose
the benefits of continuity of service, and consequently the Spring Holiday
bonus for that particular year. Exception will be made to this regulation
only in the event of a satisfactory explanation being given for any such
absence, but special approval will be required in each case to obtain
continuity of service.

In case a regular employee is unable because of illness to report for duty,
or who, on the termination of sick leave previously granted is prevented
from returning to duty or attending the appropriate dispensary owing to
the continuance of sickness, thereby rendering himself liable to incur the
penalty for absence from duty extending beyond three days without
permission, he should adopt means to notify the head of his section, who
will thereupon inform the Company's doctor. The doctor will then take
the earliest opportunity of investigating the case by visiting the employee
concerned, and either recommend the requisite sick leave or, if necessary
and possible, removal to hospital. It should be noted that the Company
will not provide medical treatment for an employee at his home.

(d) PAY DURING SICKNESS:

During absence on certified sick leave Full pay will be granted to regular
Chinese employees as follows:

Monthly rate men - not exceeding six weeks.
Daily rate men - not exceeding four weeks.

All regular Chinese staff on monthly and daily rates of pay, who are paid
full wages during absence on certified sick leave, must be sent to one of
the Company's dispensaries or to St. Luke's or the Lester Chinese Hospital,
and will be paid only on production of a certificate from the doctor to
the effect that such leave is necessary, and, further, only for such period
as may be recommended by the doctor and approved by the head of the section
concerned.

All certificates must be on the form provided by the Company which must be
signed by the section head prior to presentation to the doctor. The
doctor's report and recommendation must be handed by the man to the head
of the section concerned.

Venereal disease: No sick leave with pay will be granted in cases of
absence due to venereal disease.
page_data.zh:
第5页，共8页。

如果雇员在未事先获得许可或医疗证明的情况下缺勤超过三天，将被视为已离开公司服务。如果他随后报到上班，只能作为新人重新开始；也就是说，他将失去连续服务的福利，因此也将失去当年的春节奖金。只有在对任何此类缺勤给出令人满意的解释时，才对此规定予以例外处理，但在每种情况下都需要特别批准才能保留连续服务资格。

如果正式雇员因病无法报到上班，或者在先前批准的病假结束时，因病情持续而无法返回工作岗位或前往相应的诊疗所，从而导致其面临因未经许可缺勤超过三天而受处罚的风险，他应采取手段通知其部门主管，后者随即通知公司医生。医生将尽早通过探访相关雇员来调查此案，并建议必要的病假，或在必要且可能的情况下，将其送往医院。需要注意的是，公司不为雇员提供上门医疗服务。

(d) 病假薪资：

在持有证明的病假期间，正式华籍雇员将获得全额薪资，具体如下：

月薪制人员 - 不超过六周。
日薪制人员 - 不超过四周。

所有在持有证明的病假期间领取全额工资的月薪制和日薪制正式华籍职员，必须被送往公司的某一家诊疗所，或圣路加医院 (St. Luke's) 或雷士德华人医院 (Lester Chinese Hospital)，并且仅在出示医生证明表明此类休假是必要的，且仅限医生推荐并经相关部门主管批准的期间内，方可领取薪资。

所有证明必须使用公司提供的表格，该表格在提交给医生之前必须由部门主管签字。医生的报告和推荐信必须由当事人交给相关部门主管。

性病：因性病导致的缺勤，不给予带薪病假。

Sheet 6 of 8 sheets.

3. ENGAGEMENTS, DISCHARGES, AND DISMISSALS:

Form No. 28F-39 "Employment authorization and personal service record" will be used to record, and obtain authorization for, all engagements, discharges, and dismissals. Should any member of the foreign or local supervisory staff consider it necessary, he may suspend a man and thereafter refer the matter to the head of his section or department for consideration. Summary dismissal is not permitted.

4. MEDICAL EXAMINATION AND VACCINATION:

All Chinese employees must be medically examined (and vaccinated, if necessary) by the Company's doctor before engagement, with the exception that this rule shall not apply in the case of men who are engaged temporarily and whose engagement is therefore of a "casual" nature and unlikely to extend beyond a period of a few weeks.

All Chinese employees must be re-vaccinated against smallpox at regular intervals of not longer than three years. In the event of any Chinese employee refusing to be re-vaccinated he will lose all benefits to which he would otherwise be entitled should he at any time contract smallpox. Re-vaccination will be carried out and recorded by the Company's doctor and his staff.

5. RESIDENCE:

If required to do so by the Company, Chinese employees must reside within districts specified for the convenience of working.

6. INCREASES OF PAY:

(a) Daily-rate men: Increases may be recommended during the year for those workmen who by diligence and good work are considered to be deserving of higher rates of pay.

(b) Monthly-rate men: As a general rule, the rates of pay for Chinese on monthly rates are considered only at the end of each year.

(c) Instructions regarding recommendations for increases in pay: It is necessary to emphasise that the mere fact that a man has carried out his duties satisfactorily does not entitle him to an increase if it is considered that his present pay is sufficient for the class of work performed.

(d) Procedure: Form No. 28F-39 will be used to record, and obtain authorization for, all increases of pay.
page_data.zh:
第6页，共8页。

3. 聘用、解雇和开除：

表格第28F-39号“聘用授权及个人服务记录”将用于记录并获得所有聘用、解雇和开除的授权。如果任何外籍或本地 supervisory staff（音译：监管职员）认为有必要，他可以暂停某人的工作，然后将此事提交给其部门或科室主管审议。不允许即决开除。

4. 体检和疫苗接种：

所有华籍雇员在聘用前必须由公司医生进行体检（并在必要时接种疫苗），但临时聘用且性质属于“零工”、聘期不太可能超过几周的男子除外。

所有华籍雇员必须每隔不超过三年重新接种一次天花疫苗。如果有任何华籍雇员拒绝重新接种，若其在任何时候感染天花，将失去原本有权享受的所有福利。重新接种将由公司医生及其工作人员执行并记录。

5. 居住：

如果公司要求，华籍雇员必须居住在指定的区域内，以便工作。

6. 加薪：

(a) 日薪制人员：对于那些因勤奋和工作出色而被认为值得更高薪资的工人，可在年内推荐加薪。

(b) 月薪制人员：一般而言，华籍月薪制人员的薪资调整仅在每年年底考虑。

(c) 关于加薪推荐的指示：有必要强调，仅仅因为某人满意地履行了其职责，并不使其有权获得加薪，如果认为其目前的薪资对于所从事的工作类别已经足够的话。

(d) 程序：表格第28F-39号将用于记录并获得所有加薪的授权。

page_data.en:
Sheet 7 of 8 sheets.

7. TESTIMONIALS TO CHINESE EMPLOYEES:
No testimonials may be given on the Company's forms or letter headings, it having always been the policy of the Company not to issue testimonials to Chinese employees. The Company may, however, at its discretion, answer inquiries from prospective employers.

8. ACCEPTANCE OF PRESENTS:
The attention of the supervisory staff is directed to the necessity of an unqualified refusal to accept presents emanating from individual members or groups of the Chinese staff.

9. CONTRACTING OF LOANS:
The contracting of monetary loans between employees is not permitted and would be regarded as a serious offence against the interests of the Company.

10. CASUAL LABOR:
The conditions applicable to this grade are as follows :-

(a) Notice and paying off: Minimum notice to be one hour. Men finishing one day to be paid up on the following afternoon. The Chinese Staff Office to be notified the afternoon the men are finishing and time sheets to be in early the following morning, pay should not be held over week-ends and holidays and arrangements to be made accordingly.

(b) Spring Holiday Bonus: Not paid.

(c) Death due to accident while legitimately employed: We pay funeral allowance. A death gratuity may be issued at the discretion of the Company.

(d) Death (not on duty): No allowance whatever.

(e) Injury on duty: We provide medical treatment, sick pay, and hospital expenses. An invaliding gratuity may be issued at the discretion of the Company.

(f) Sickness other than injury on duty: No medical treatment, sick pay, hospital expenses, or invaliding gratuity.

(g) Pay increases: No service increase, but pay will go up pro rata with any general increase.
page_data.zh:
第7页，共8页。

7. 华员证明书：
不得在公司表格或信头纸上出具任何证明书，因为公司一贯的政策是不向华员发放证明书。然而，公司可自行决定是否回复未来雇主的查询。

8. 接受礼物：
提请管理人员注意，必须无条件拒绝接受来自华员个人或团体赠送的礼物。

9. 借贷行为：
员工之间不得发生金钱借贷关系，此类行为将被视为严重损害公司利益。

10. 临时工（Casual Labor）：
适用于此等级员工的条件如下：-

(a) 通知与解雇结算：最短通知期为一小时。当日工作结束的员工应于次日下午结清工资。应在员工工作结束的当天下午通知华员办事处，考勤表应于次日清晨尽早提交，工资不得在周末和节假日积压，应据此做出相应安排。

(b) 春节奖金：不予发放。

(c) 受雇期间因事故死亡：我们支付丧葬津贴。公司可自行决定是否发放抚恤金。

(d) 非因公死亡：无任何津贴。

(e) 因公受伤：我们提供医疗、病假工资及住院费用。公司可自行决定是否发放伤残抚恤金。

(f) 非因公受伤的疾病：不提供医疗、病假工资、住院费用或伤残抚恤金。

(g) 加薪：无工龄加薪，但工资将随任何普遍性加薪按比例增加。

(h) Holidays: No payment for 'holidays with pay'. If working on 'holidays
with pay' will get overtime rates only, (e.g., at the Spring Holiday would
get double, not triple pay).

(i) Retirement gratuity: None.

(j) Overtime: Usual rates apply.

(k) Caps or hats: Not provided.

(l) Badges: Special badges to be provided and worn on arm.

(m) Transfer: If transferred to regular staff, previous service not to be
taken into account.

(n) Pay: To be $0.05 per day more than minimum coolie rate.

(o) Rice allowance: As for regular employees.

11. TEMPORARY EMPLOYEES:

Where applicable, the conditions for casual labor will be followed for
temporary employees.

W. S. HEALY,
Vice President & General Manager.

第8页，共8页。

(h) 节假日：不支付“带薪节假日”工资。若在“带薪节假日”工作，仅按加班费率支付（例如，春节期间将获得双倍而非三倍工资）。

(i) 退休抚恤金：无。

(j) 加班费：适用通常费率。

(k) 帽子：不提供。

(l) 徽章：将提供特制徽章并佩戴于手臂上。

(m) 转岗：若转入正式员工编制，此前的服务年限不予计算。

(n) 工资：比最低苦力日薪高出 $0.05。

(o) 米贴：与正式员工相同。

11. 临时雇员（Temporary Employees）：

如适用，临时雇员将遵循临时工的条件。

W. S. HEALY,
副总裁兼总经理。

General conditions of service (in Control No.3)
STAFF ORDER No.3/1

SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY

REGULAR CHINESE STAFF

SUMMARY OF GENERAL CONDITIONS OF SERVICE AND
BENEFITS, AND INSTRUCTIONS ON VARIOUS MATTERS
APPERTAINING TO CHINESE EMPLOYEES (INCLUDING
LOCAL APPOINTEES).

1. CHINESE PROVIDENT SCHEME:

(a) Spring Holiday bonus: The bonuses stated below
will be issued annually at the Spring Holiday:-

A. To every Chinese employee who has served con-
tinuously during the whole of the preceding
twelve months but has not completed ten years'
continuous service - Half of one month's or-
dinary pay.

B. To every Chinese employee who has completed
ten years', or more, continuous service -
One month's ordinary pay.

(b) Funeral expenses and proof of death: On the death
of any Chinese employee a gratuity of $60 will be
issued as funeral expenses. This sum will be paid
to the person or persons considered fit and proper
to receive it. This gratuity is payable irrespec-
tive of length of service, but only after proof
of death and identification of the employee has
been clearly established. The head of the depart-
ment concerned must immediately notify the Chinese
Staff Office in the case of the death of any
Chinese employee, giving full particulars of lo-
cation of the deceased, etc., whereupon the neces-
sary action will be taken to establish identity.

(c) Death gratuity: On the death of any Chinese em-
ployee a gratuity equal to five per cent of the
monthly ordinary pay drawn by such employee at
the time of his death will be payable in respect
of each complete month of continuous service.
This gratuity will be paid to the person or per-
sons considered fit and proper to receive it, but
only after proof of death and identification of
the employee has been clearly established.

(d) Invaliding gratuity: In the event of it being
necessary to invalid any Chinese employee out of
the service of the Company, under medical certi-
ficate, he will be entitled to receive a sum
equal to five per cent of the monthly ordinary
pay being drawn by him at the date of such in-
validing in respect of each complete month of con-
tinuous service, upon favourable recommendation
in each case by the General Manager. The official
date of invaliding shall be one week after the
medical certificate is passed by the General
Manager.

服务通则（见控制号 No.3）
员工令 No.3/1

上海电力公司

正式华员

华员（包括本地聘用人员）服务通则及福利摘要及相关事项指示

1. 华员公积金计划：

(a) 春节奖金：下列奖金将于每年春节发放：-

A. 凡在过去十二个月内连续服务但未完成十年连续服务的每位华员——半个月普通工资。

B. 凡已完成十年或以上连续服务的每位华员——一个月普通工资。

(b) 丧葬费用及死亡证明：任何华员身故时，将发放 $60 作为丧葬费用的抚恤金。该款项将支付给被认为适宜接收的人员。无论服务年限长短，均可领取此抚恤金，但必须在明确证实死亡及确认员工身份后方可支付。如有华员身故，相关部门主管必须立即通知华员办事处，提供死者地点等详细情况，随后将采取必要措施以确认身份。

(c) 死亡抚恤金：任何华员身故时，按其身故时每月普通工资的百分之五，就其连续服务的每个完整月份支付抚恤金。该抚恤金将支付给被认为适宜接收的人员，但必须在明确证实死亡及确认员工身份后方可支付。

(d) 伤残抚恤金：如有必要根据医疗证明使任何华员因病退职，经总经理在个案中给予有利推荐后，他有权按其退职之日每月普通工资的百分之五，就其连续服务的每个完整月份领取一笔款项。官方退职日期应为总经理批准医疗证明后的一周。

(e) Retirement gratuity: The gratuities stated below
will be issued on retirement or discharge:-

A. To every Chinese employee whose services are
terminated by the Company (except for miscon-
duct) after the completion of one year's con-
tinuous service and before the completion of
twenty years' continuous service.

An amount, computed as under noted -

METHOD OF COMPUTATION

(1) One-third of one per cent will be multi-
plied by the number of completed years of
continuous service.

(2) The percentage produced under (1) but sub-
ject to a maximum of five per cent will be
applied to the annual ordinary pay being
drawn by the employee at the date of dis-
charge.

(3) The amount produced under (2) will be mul-
tiplied by the period of continuous ser-
vice expressed in terms of years to the
last completed month, e.g., 5 years and 7
months = 5-7/12, to arrive at the gratuity.

(4) Expressed as formulae, the foregoing method
of computation is represented by :-

I. Under fifteen years' continuous service -

1 x (No. of completed years) x (Annual pay) x (No. of completed months)
——————————————————————————————————————————————— = Gratuity
3 x 100 x 12

II. Fifteen years' or more continuous service -

(Annual pay) x 5 x (No. of completed months)
——————————————————————————————— = Gratuity
1 x 100 x 12

(5) The minimum gratuity to be two per cent
of the annual pay being drawn by the em-
ployee at the date of discharge.

Formula:- (Annual pay) x 2
——————————— = (Minimum Gratuity)
100

This benefit applies only to men discharged
by the Company, and not to men leaving of
their own accord, to whom the qualification
of twenty years' continuous service stated
in B applies.
