- 2 -

(e) 退休抚恤金：下列抚恤金将在退休或解雇时发放：-

A. 凡连续服务满一年但未满二十年，且由公司终止服务（除行为不端外）的每位华员。

金额计算如下——

计算方法

(1) 将百分之零点三三乘以连续服务的完整年数。

(2) 将 (1) 项得出的百分比（最高不超过百分之五）应用于员工在被解雇之日所领取的年度普通工资。

(3) 将 (2) 项得出的金额乘以以年表示的连续服务期限（精确到最后一个完整月），例如，5年7个月 = 5-7/12，从而得出抚恤金。

(4) 用公式表示，上述计算方法为：-

I. 连续服务不满十五年——

1 x (完整年数) x (年薪) x (完整月数)
——————————————————————————————————————————————— = 抚恤金
3 x 100 x 12

II. 连续服务十五年或以上——

(年薪) x 5 x (完整月数)
——————————————————————————————— = 抚恤金
1 x 100 x 12

(5) 最低抚恤金为员工在被解雇之日所领取年薪的百分之二。

公式：- (年薪) x 2
——————————— = (最低抚恤金)
100

此项福利仅适用于由公司解雇的员工，不适用于自行离职者；对于自行离职者，适用 B 项中规定的二十年连续服务资格。

page_data.en:
B. To every Chinese employee on resignation or discharge at any time after the completion of twenty years' continuous service -

An amount equal to five per cent of the monthly ordinary pay being drawn by the employee at the date of leaving the Company's service multiplied by the number of completed months of continuous service.
Formula:- Same as A (4) II.

(f) Injury on duty: In the event of any Chinese employee being killed during the execution of his duty, or whose death or invaliding is due to causes arising directly out of the performance of duty, the "Death" or "Invaliding" gratuity will be the subject of special consideration in each case.

(g) Next-of-kin - particulars required: All members of the Chinese staff are required to provide information regarding their next-of-kin. Any man refusing to supply such information will not be allowed to participate in any of the benefits under the Provident Scheme.

2. DISPENSARIES, MEDICAL TREATMENT, PERIOD OF ABSENCE ALLOWED, PAY DURING SICKNESS, ETC:

(a) DISPENSARIES

(1) Dispensaries provided. Dispensaries have been established at Riverside and Pearson Road for the purpose of giving medical out-patient treatment to members of the Chinese staff.

(2) Treatment free of charge: Such treatment as that referred to in paragraph (a) will be provided free of charge, subject to the following conditions being observed:-

(3) How to obtain treatment: Application for treatment at a dispensary must be made on the printed form provided by the Company. Before treatment can be given this form must first be signed by the head of the section in which the applicant is engaged, and then presented by the man requiring treatment to the doctor-in-charge.

(4) Where to obtain treatment: No treatment can be given by the Doctor-in-charge of the dispensaries to any of the Chinese staff except on the premises of the Company.

(5) Hours to attend: The dispensaries will be open at the following times: -

May 1 to September 30:

Pearson Road -
Monday to Saturday (inclusive) 8.30a.m. - 11.30am.

Riverside -
Monday to Friday (inclusive) 2.00p.m. - 4.30 p.m.
Saturdays 9.00a.m. - 12.00 noon
page_data.zh:
B. 凡在完成二十年连续服务后的任何时候辞职或被解雇的每位华员——

金额等于员工在离开公司服务之日所领取的每月普通工资的百分之五，乘以连续服务的完整月数。
公式：- 同 A (4) II。

(f) 因公受伤：如有任何华员在执行职务期间身亡，或其死亡或伤残系由直接源于履行职务的原因造成，则“死亡”或“伤残”抚恤金将在每个个案中予以特别考虑。

(g) 近亲——所需详情：所有华员均需提供其近亲的信息。任何拒绝提供此类信息的人员将不得参与公积金计划下的任何福利。

2. 诊疗所、医疗、准许缺勤期限、病假工资等：

(a) 诊疗所

(1) 设立诊疗所。已在 Riverside 和 Pearson Road 设立诊疗所，旨在为华员提供门诊医疗服务。

(2) 免费治疗：在遵守以下条件的前提下，(a) 段所述的治疗将免费提供：-

(3) 如何获得治疗：申请在诊疗所接受治疗必须使用公司提供的印刷表格。在治疗开始前，该表格必须先由申请人所在部门的主管签字，然后由需要治疗的员工呈交给主治医生。

(4) 何处获得治疗：除非在公司场所内，否则诊疗所的主治医生不得为任何华员提供治疗。

(5) 就诊时间：诊疗所开放时间如下：-

5月1日至9月30日：

Pearson Road -
周一至周六（含）上午 8:30 - 11:30。

Riverside -
周一至周五（含）下午 2:00 - 4:30。
周六上午 9:00 - 中午 12:00

page_data.en:
- 4 -

October 1 to April 30:

Pearson Road -
Monday to Saturday (inclusive; 9.00 a.m. to 11.30 a.m.

Riverside -
Monday to Friday (inclusive) 2.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m.
Saturdays 9.00 a.m. to 12.00 noon.

The dispensaries will be closed on Sundays and
general holidays.

(a) Sending to hospital: It should be noted that in
cases where Chinese employees are concerned, they
should be sent to one of the dispensaries for
treatment, unless there are special reasons for
sending them to hospital such as injury or duty,
or where in-patient hospital treatment is neces-
sary, in which event they should be sent either
to St. Luke's Hospital, 159eward Road, or to
the Joster Chinese Hospital, 31C Shantung Road.

(b) MEDICAL AND HOSPITAL TREATMENT FOR REGULAR CHINESE
STAFF:

The ordinary fees of the hospitals will be paid by
the Company but fees for special accommodation,
special treatment, or operations, will not be paid
unless previously sanctioned by the General Manager.

The Company reserves the right to terminate the
services of Chinese employees during sickness, in
which case payment of hospital fees would cease
forthwith. In such cases of termination of ser-
vices the hospital concerned will be immediately
advised in writing by the Chinese Staff Office to
this effect.

(c) ABSENCES FROM DUTY:

The absence on certified sick leave, (or for any
other reason), of any regular employee for a period
exceeding six weeks in the case of monthly rate
men and four weeks for daily rate men must be re-
ported by the section head under whom he is working
to the head of the department concerned in order
that the advisability or otherwise of invalidating
may be decided, and no pay can be issued after the
expiry of such periods without special approval.

If an employee absents himself from duty for a
period of more than three days without first ob-
taining permission or a medical certificate he will
be treated as having left the service of the Com-
pany. If he subsequently reports for duty he can
only recommence as a new man, that is, he will lose
the benefits of continuity of service, and conse-
quently the Spring Holiday bonus for that particular
year. Exception will be made to this regulation
only in the event of a satisfactory explanation
being given for any such absence, but special appro-
val will be required in each case to obtain con-
tinuity of service.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

10月1日至4月30日：

Pearson Road -
周一至周六（含）上午 9:00 至 11:30。

Riverside -
周一至周五（含）下午 2:00 至 5:00。
周六上午 9:00 至 中午 12:00。

诊疗所在周日和公共假日关闭。

(a) 送院治疗：需注意，涉及华员时，除非有特殊理由（如因公受伤或需要住院治疗），否则应将其送往诊疗所接受治疗；如需住院治疗，应送往位于 Ward Road 159号的圣路加医院（St. Luke's Hospital），或位于山东路31C号的 Joster 华人医院（Joster Chinese Hospital）。

(b) 正式华员的医疗及住院治疗：

公司将支付医院的常规费用，但除非事先经总经理批准，否则不支付特殊病房、特殊治疗或手术的费用。

公司保留在华员患病期间终止其服务的权利，在此情况下，医院费用的支付将立即停止。在此类终止服务的情况下，华员办事处将立即书面通知相关医院。

(c) 缺勤：

月薪制员工请假超过六周，或日薪制员工请假超过四周（凭证明的病假或其他原因），其所在部门主管必须向相关部门主管报告，以便决定是否宜予病退；未经特别批准，在上述期限届满后不得发放工资。

如果员工在未事先获得许可或医疗证明的情况下缺勤超过三天，将被视为已离开公司服务。如果他随后报到复工，只能作为新员工重新开始，即他将失去连续服务的福利，从而失去当年的春节奖金。只有在对任何此类缺勤给出令人满意的解释时，才可对此规定予以例外，但在每种情况下均需特别批准才能获得连续服务资格。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

In case a regular employee is unable because of
illness to report for duty, or who, on the termina-
tion of sick leave previously granted is prevented
from returning to duty or attending the appropriate
dispensary owing to the continuance of sickness,
thereby rendering himself liable to incur the penalty
for absence from duty extending beyond three days
without permission, he should adopt means to notify
the head of his section, who will thereupon inform
the Company's doctor. The doctor will then take
the earliest opportunity of investigating the case
by visiting the employee concerned, and either re-
commend the requisite sick leave or, if necessary
and possible, removal to hospital. It should be
noted that the Company will not provide medical
treatment for an employee at his home.

(a) PAY DURING SICKNESS:

During absence on certified sick leave full pay
will be granted to regular Chinese employees as
follows:

Monthly rate men - not exceeding six weeks.
Daily rate men - not exceeding four weeks.

All regular Chinese staff on monthly and daily rates
of pay, who are paid full wages during absence on
certified sick leave, must be sent to one of the,
Company's dispensaries or to St. Luke's or the Lester
Chinese Hospital, and will be paid only on production
of a certificate from the doctor to the effect that
such leave is necessary, and, further, only for such
period as may be recommended by the doctor and ap-
proved by the head of the section concerned.

All certificates must be on the form provided by the
Company which must be signed by the section head
prior to presentation to the doctor. The doctor's
report and recommendation must be handed by the man
to the head of the section concerned.

Venereal disease: No sick leave with pay will be
granted in cases of absence due to venereal disease.

3. ENGAGEMENTS, DISCHARGES, AND DISMISSALS:

Form No. 28F-59 "Employment authorization and per-
sonal service record" will be used to record, and
obtain authorization for, all engagements, discharges,
and dismissals. Should any member of the foreign
or local supervisory staff consider it necessary,
he may suspend a man and thereafter refer the matter
to the head of his section or department for consi-
deration. Summary dismissal is not permitted.

4. MEDICAL EXAMINATION AND VACCINATION:

All Chinese employees must be medically examined
(and vaccinated, if necessary) by the Company's doc-
tor before engagement, with the exception that this
rule shall not apply in the case of men who are en-
gaged temporarily and whose engagement is therefore
of a "casual" nature and unlikely to extend beyond
a period of a few weeks.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

若正式雇员因病无法报到履职，或在先前批准的病假结束后，因病情持续而无法返岗或前往指定的诊疗所就诊，从而导致其面临因未经许可缺勤超过三天而受处罚的风险时，该雇员应采取手段通知其所在部门的主管，主管随后将通知公司医生。医生将尽早通过探访相关雇员来调查此事，并建议给予必要的病假，或在必要且可行的情况下，将其移送医院。需注意，公司不提供上门医疗服务。

(a) 病假期间的薪资：

在持有证明的病假期间，正式华籍雇员的全额薪资发放规定如下：

月薪制人员——不超过六周。
日薪制人员——不超过四周。

所有在持有证明的病假期间领取全额工资的月薪制和日薪制正式华籍职员，必须被送往公司的某一家诊疗所，或圣路加医院（St. Luke's）或莱斯特长老会医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），且仅在出示医生开具的证明表明该休假确有必要，并且仅限医生推荐并经相关部门主管批准的期限内，方可领取薪资。

所有证明必须使用公司提供的表格，且在提交给医生之前必须由部门主管签字。医生的报告和建议必须由当事人交给相关部门主管。

性病：因性病导致的缺勤，不给予带薪病假。

3. 聘用、解聘及开除：

第 28F-59 号表格“聘用授权及个人服务记录”将用于记录并获得所有聘用、解聘及开除事项的授权。若外籍或本地 supervisory staff（监管/管理人员）的任何成员认为有必要，可暂停某人的工作，随后将此事项提交其所在部门或科室的主管审议。不允许即决开除（Summary dismissal）。

4. 体检与疫苗接种：

所有华籍雇员在受聘前必须接受公司医生的体检（并在必要时接种疫苗），但此规定不适用于临时雇用的人员，因为其雇用性质属于“临时性”（casual），且不太可能持续数周以上。

page_data.en:
- 6 -

All Chinese employees must be re-vaccinated against
smallpox at regular intervals of not longer than
three years. In the event of any Chinese employee
refusing to be re-vaccinated he will lose all
benefits to which he would otherwise be entitled
should he at any time contract smallpox. Re-vaccina-
tion will be carried out and recorded by the Com-
pany's doctor and his staff.

5. RESIDENCE:

If required to do so by the Company, Chinese employees
must reside within districts specified for the con-
venience of working.

6. INCREASES OF PAY:

(a) Daily-rate men: Increases may be recommended
during the year for those workmen who by dili-
gence and good work are considered to be de-
serving of higher rates of pay.

(b) Monthly-rate men: As a general rule, the rates
of pay for Chinese on monthly rates are con-
sidered only at the end of each year.

(c) Instructions regarding recommendations for
increases in pay: It is necessary to emphasize
that the mere fact that a man has carried out
his duties satisfactorily does not entitle him
to an increase if it is considered that his
present pay is sufficient for the class of
work performed.

(d) Procedure: Form No. 28F-39 will be used to
record, and obtain authorization for, all in-
creases of pay.

7. TESTIMONIALS TO CHINESE EMPLOYEES:

No testimonials may be given on the Company's forms
or letter headings, it having always been the policy
of the Company not to issue testimonials to Chinese
employees. The Company may, however, at its dis-
cretion, answer inquiries from prospective employers.

8. ACCEPTANCE OF PRESENTS:

The attention of the supervisory staff is directed
to the necessity of an unqualified refusal to accept
presents emanating from individual members or
groups of the Chinese staff.

9. CONTRACTING OF LOANS:

The contracting of monetary loans between employees
is not permitted and would be regarded as a serious
offence against the interests of the Company.

10. CASUAL LABOR:

The conditions applicable to this grade are as follows:-

(a) Notice and paying off: Minimum notice to be one
hour. Men finishing one day to be paid up on
the following afternoon. The Chinese Staff
Office to be notified the afternoon the men are
finishing and time sheets to be in early the
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

所有华籍雇员必须每隔不超过三年重新接种一次天花疫苗。若任何华籍雇员拒绝重新接种，一旦其在任何时候感染天花，将丧失原本有权享有的所有福利。重新接种将由公司医生及其工作人员执行并记录。

5. 居住：

若公司要求，华籍雇员必须居住在为方便工作而指定的区域内。

6. 加薪：

(a) 日薪制人员：对于那些因勤奋和工作表现良好而被认为值得获得更高薪资的工人，可在年内建议加薪。

(b) 月薪制人员：一般而言，华籍月薪制人员的薪资调整仅在每年年底考虑。

(c) 关于加薪建议的指示：必须强调，仅仅因为某人令人满意地履行了其职责，并不使其有权获得加薪，如果认为其目前的薪资对于所从事的工作类别而言已经足够的话。

(d) 程序：第 28F-39 号表格将用于记录并获得所有加薪事项的授权。

7. 给华籍雇员的推荐信：

不得在公司表格或信头上出具推荐信，因为公司一贯的政策是不向华籍雇员发放推荐信。然而，公司可自行决定是否回复潜在雇主的查询。

8. 收受礼物：

提请监管/管理人员注意，必须无条件拒绝接受来自华籍职员个人或团体赠送的礼物。

9. 借贷：

不允许雇员之间进行金钱借贷，这将被视为严重损害公司利益的行为。

10. 临时工（Casual Labor）：

适用于此等级的条件如下：-

(a) 通知与结算工资：最短通知时间为一小时。当日完工的人员应在次日下午结清工资。华人职员办公室应在人员完工的当天下午收到通知，工时单应在次日清晨尽早送达。

page_data.en:
- 7 -

following morning. Pay should not be held over
week-ends and holidays and arrangements to be
made accordingly.

(b) Spring Holiday Bonus: Not paid.

(c) Death due to accident while legitimately employed:
We pay funeral allowance. A death gratuity may
be issued at the discretion of the Company.

(d) Death (not on duty): No allowance whatever.

(e) Injury on duty: We provide medical treatment,
sick pay, and hospital expenses. An invaliding
gratuity may be issued at the discretion of the
Company.

(f) Sickness other than injury on duty: No medical
treatment, sick pay, hospital expenses, or
invaliding gratuity.

(g) Pay increases: No service increase, but pay
will go up pro rata with any general increase.

(h) Holidays: No payment for 'holidays with pay'.
If working on 'holidays with pay' will get
overtime rates only, (e.g., at the Spring Holiday
would get double, not triple pay).

(i) Retirement gratuity: None.

(j) Overtime: Usual rates apply.

(k) Caps or hats: Not provided.

(l) Badges: Special badges to be provided and worn
on duty.

(m) Transfer: If transferred to regular staff, pre-
vious service not to be taken into account.

(n) Pay: To be $0.05 per day more than minimum
coolie rate.

(o) Rice allowance: As for regular employees.

11. TEMPORARY EMPLOYEES:

Where applicable, the conditions for casual labor
will be followed for temporary employees.

W. S. Huard,
Vice President & General Manager.
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

工资不应跨越周末和节假日滞留，应据此做出安排。

(b) 春节奖金：不支付。

(c) 在合法受雇期间因事故死亡：我们支付丧葬津贴。抚恤金可由公司酌情发放。

(d) 死亡（非执勤期间）：无任何津贴。

(e) 执勤期间受伤：我们提供医疗救治、病假工资和住院费用。残疾抚恤金可由公司酌情发放。

(f) 除执勤受伤外的疾病：不提供医疗救治、病假工资、住院费用或残疾抚恤金。

(g) 加薪：无基于服务的加薪，但薪资将随任何普遍加薪按比例增加。

(h) 节假日：不支付“带薪节假日”工资。若在“带薪节假日”工作，仅获得加班费率，（例如，在春节期间将获得双倍工资，而非三倍工资）。

(i) 退休抚恤金：无。

(j) 加班费：适用通常费率。

(k) 帽子：不提供。

(l) 徽章：需提供特殊徽章，并在执勤时佩戴。

(m) 调动：若调至正式职员队伍，此前的服务年限不予计算。

(n) 薪资：比最低苦力费率每天多 $0.05。

(o) 米贴：与正式雇员相同。

11. 临时雇员：

在适用的情况下，临时雇员将遵循临时工的条件。

W. S. Huard,
副总裁兼总经理。

General conditions of service (in Control No..)
STAFF ORDER NO.3/1

SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY

REGULAR CHINESE STAFF

SUMMARY OF GENERAL CONDITIONS OF SERVICE AND
BENEFITS, AND INSTRUCTIONS ON VARIOUS MATTERS
APPERTAINING TO CHINESE EMPLOYEES (EXCLUDING
LOCAL APPOINTEES).

1. CHINESE PROVIDENT SCHEME:

(a) Spring Holiday bonus: The bonuses stated below
will be issued annually at the Spring Holiday:-

A. To every Chinese employee who has served con-
tinuously during the whole of the preceding
twelve months but has not completed ten years'
continuous service - Half of one month's or-
dinary pay.

B. To every Chinese employee who has completed
ten years', or more, continuous service -
One month's ordinary pay.

(b) Funeral expenses and proof of death: On the death
of any Chinese employee a gratuity of $60 will be
issued as funeral expenses. This sum will be paid
to the person or persons considered fit and proper
to receive it. This gratuity is payable irrespec-
tive of length of service, but only after proof
of death and identification of the employee has
been clearly established. The head of the depart-
ment concerned must immediately notify the Chinese
Staff Office in the case of the death of any
Chinese employee, giving full particulars of lo-
cation of the deceased, etc., whereupon the neces-
sary action will be taken to establish identity.

(c) Death gratuity: On the death of any Chinese em-
ployee a gratuity equal to five per cent of the
monthly ordinary pay drawn by such employee at
the time of his death will be payable in respect
of each complete month of continuous service.
This gratuity will be paid to the person or per-
sons considered fit and proper to receive it, but
only after proof of death and identification of
the employee has been clearly established.

(d) Invaliding gratuity: In the event of it being
necessary to invalid any Chinese employee out of
the service of the Company, under medical certi-
ficate, he will be entitled to receive a sum
equal to five per cent of the monthly ordinary
pay being drawn by him at the date of such in-
validing in respect of each complete month of con-
tinuous service, upon favourable recommendation
in each case by the General Manager. The official
date of invaliding shall be one week after the
medical certificate is passed by the General
Manager.

一般服务条件（控制编号..）
职员命令第 3/1 号

上海电力公司

正式华籍职员

一般服务条件及福利摘要，以及关于华籍雇员（不包括本地聘任人员）各项事宜的指示。

1. 华籍雇员公积金计划：

(a) 春节奖金：以下所述的奖金将在每年春节发放：-

A. 向每一位在前十二个月内连续服务但未完成十年连续服务的华籍雇员——发放半个月的基本薪资。

B. 向每一位已完成十年或以上连续服务的华籍雇员——发放一个月的基本薪资。

(b) 丧葬费用及死亡证明：任何华籍雇员去世时，将发放 $60 作为丧葬费用的抚恤金。这笔款项将支付给被认为合适且正当的接收人。无论服务年限长短，均可支付此笔抚恤金，但必须在明确确立死亡证明及雇员身份之后。在任何华籍雇员去世的情况下，相关部门主管必须立即通知华人职员办公室，提供死者所在地等详细信息，随后将采取必要行动以确认身份。

(c) 死亡抚恤金：任何华籍雇员去世时，就其连续服务的每一个完整月份，应支付相当于该雇员去世时所领取的月基本薪资百分之五的抚恤金。此笔抚恤金将支付给被认为合适且正当的接收人，但必须在明确确立死亡证明及雇员身份之后。

(d) 残疾抚恤金：若有必要根据医疗证明使任何华籍雇员因公致残退出公司服务，经总经理在个案中给予有利推荐后，其有权就连续服务的每一个完整月份，领取相当于其致残日期所领取的月基本薪资百分之五的金额。官方致残日期应为总经理批准医疗证明后的一周。

- 2 -

(e) Retirement gratuity: The gratuities stated below
will be issued on retirement or discharge:-

A. To every Chinese employee whose services are
terminated by the Company (except for miscon-
duct) after the completion of one year's con-
tinuous service and before the completion of
twenty years' continuous service.

An amount, computed as under noted -

METHOD OF COMPUTATION

(1) One-third of one per cent will be multi-
plied by the number of completed years of
continuous service.

(2) The percentage produced under (1) but sub-
ject to a maximum of five per cent will be
applied to the annual ordinary pay being
drawn by the employee at the date of dis-
charge.

(3) The amount produced under (2) will be mul-
tiplied by the period of continuous ser-
vice expressed in terms of years to the
last completed month, e.g., 5 years and 7
months = 5-7/12, to arrive at the gratuity.

(4) Expressed as formulae, the foregoing method
of computation is represented by :-

I. Under fifteen years' continuous service -

l x (No. of completed years) x (Annual pay) x (No. of completed months) / (3 x 100 x 12) = Gratuity

II. Fifteen years', or more, continuous service -

(Annual pay) x 5 x (No. of completed months) / (1 x 100 x 12) = Gratuity

(5) The minimum gratuity to be two per cent
of the annual pay being drawn by the em-
ployee at the date of discharge.

Formula:- (Annual pay) x 2 / 100 = (Minimum Gratuity)

This benefit applies only to men discharged
by the Company, and not to men leaving of
their own accord, to whom the qualification
of twenty years' continuous service stated
in B applies.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

(e) 退休抚恤金：以下所述的抚恤金将在退休或解聘时发放：-

A. 向每一位在完成一年连续服务后、但在完成二十年连续服务前，由公司终止服务（不当行为除外）的华籍雇员。

金额计算如下所述 -

计算方法

(1) 将百分之零点三三（三分之一百分之一）乘以连续服务的完整年数。

(2) 将 (1) 项得出的百分比（但最高不超过百分之五）应用于雇员在解聘日期所领取的年基本薪资。

(3) 将 (2) 项得出的金额乘以以年表示的连续服务期限（精确到最后一个完整月），例如，5 年 7 个月 = 5-7/12，从而得出抚恤金。

(4) 用公式表示，上述计算方法表示为：-

I. 连续服务不满十五年 -

l x (完整年数) x (年薪) x (完整月数) / (3 x 100 x 12) = 抚恤金

II. 连续服务十五年或以上 -

(年薪) x 5 x (完整月数) / (1 x 100 x 12) = 抚恤金

(5) 最低抚恤金为雇员在解聘日期所领取年薪的百分之二。

公式：- (年薪) x 2 / 100 = (最低抚恤金)

此项福利仅适用于由公司解聘的人员，而不适用于自愿离职的人员，后者适用 B 项中所述的二十年连续服务资格要求。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

B. To every Chinese employee on resignation or discharge at any time after the completion of twenty years' continuous service -

An amount equal to five per cent of the monthly ordinary pay being drawn by the employee at the date of leaving the Company's service multiplied by the number of completed months of continuous service.
Formula:- Same as A (4) II.

(f) Injury on duty: In the event of any Chinese employee being killed during the execution of his duty, or whose death or invaliding is due to causes arising directly out of the performance of duty, the "Death" or "Invaliding" gratuity will be the subject of special consideration in each case.

(g) Next-of-kin - particulars required: All members of the Chinese staff are required to provide information regarding their next-of-kin. Any men refusing to supply such information will not be allowed to participate in any of the benefits under the Provident Scheme.

2. DISPENSARIES, MEDICAL TREATMENT, PERIODS OF ABSENCE ALLOWED, PAY DURING SICKNESS, ETC:

(a) DISPENSARIES

(1) Dispensaries provided: Dispensaries have been established at Riverside and Pearson Road for the purpose of giving medical out-patient treatment to members of the Chinese staff.

(2) Treatment free of charge: Such treatment as that referred to in paragraph (a) will be provided free of charge, subject to the following conditions being observed:-

(3) How to obtain treatment: Application for treatment at a dispensary must be made on the printed form provided by the Company. Before treatment can be given this form must first be signed by the head of the section in which the applicant is engaged, and then presented by the man requiring treatment to the doctor-in-charge.

(4) Where to obtain treatment: No treatment can be given by the Doctor-in-charge of the dispensaries to any of the Chinese staff except on the premises of the Company.

(5) Hours to attend: The dispensaries will be open at the following times: -

May 1 to September 30):

Pearson Road -
Monday to Saturday(inclusive) 8.30a.m. - 11.30am.

Riverside -
Monday to Friday (inclusive) 2.00p.m. - 4.30 pm.
Saturdays 9.00a.m. -12.00 noon
page_data.zh:

B. 凡连续服务满二十年后，在任何时候辞职或被解雇的华籍雇员——

金额等于该雇员在离开本公司服务之日所领取的月薪普通工资的百分之五，乘以连续服务的完整月数。
公式：同 A (4) II。

(f) 因公受伤：如有任何华籍雇员在执行职务期间死亡，或其死亡或致残系由直接源于履行职务的原因所致，则“死亡”或“致残”抚恤金将在每个案件中予以特别考虑。

(g) 最近亲属——所需详情：所有华籍职员均须提供其最近亲属的信息。任何拒绝提供此类信息者，不得参与公积金计划项下的任何福利。

2. 诊疗所、医疗待遇、准假期限、病假工资等：

(a) 诊疗所

(1) 设立的诊疗所：已在 Riverside（音译）和 Pearson Road（音译）设立诊疗所，旨在为华籍职员提供门诊医疗服务。

(2) 免费治疗：上述 (a) 段所述之治疗将免费提供，但须遵守以下条件：

(3) 如何获得治疗：申请在诊疗所接受治疗必须使用本公司提供的印刷表格。在治疗开始前，该表格必须先由申请人所在部门的负责人签字，然后由需要治疗的员工呈交给主治医生。

(4) 何处获得治疗：除在本公司场所内外，诊疗所的主治医生不得向任何华籍职员提供治疗。

(5) 就诊时间：诊疗所开放时间为：

5月1日至9月30日：

Pearson Road（音译）——
周一至周六（含）上午8:30 – 上午11:30。

Riverside（音译）——
周一至周五（含）下午2:00 – 下午4:30。
周六上午9:00 – 中午12:00

October 1 to April 30:

Fearon Road -
Monday to Saturday (inclusive) 9.00a.m. to 11.30 a.m.

Riverside -
Monday to Friday (inclusive) 2.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m.
Saturdays 9:00 a.m. to 12.00 noon.

The dispensaries will be closed on Sundays and
general holidays.

(a) Sending to hospital: It should be noted that in
cases where Chinese employees are concerned, they
should be sent to one of the dispensaries for
treatment, unless there are special reasons for
sending them to hospital such as injury on duty,
or where in-patient hospital treatment is neces-
sary, in which event they should be sent either
to St. Luke's Hospital, 159 Seward Road, or to
the Lester Chinese Hospital, 310 Shantung Road.

(b) MEDICAL AND HOSPITAL TREATMENT FOR REGULAR CHINESE
STAFF:

The ordinary fees of the hospitals will be paid by
the Company but fees for special accommodation,
special treatment, or operations, will not be paid
unless previously sanctioned by the General Manager.

The Company retains the right to terminate the
services of Chinese employees during sickness, in
which case payment of hospital fees would cease
forthwith. In such cases of termination of ser-
vices the hospital concerned will be immediately
advised in writing by the Chinese Staff Office to
this effect.

(c) ABSENCES FROM DUTY:

The absence on certified sick leave, (or for any
other reason), of any regular employee for a period
exceeding six weeks in the case of monthly rate
men and four weeks for daily rate men must be re-
ported by the section head under whom he is working
to the head of the department concerned in order
that the advisability or otherwise of invaliding
may be decided, and no pay can be issued after the
expiry of such periods without special approval.

If an employee absents himself from duty for a
period of more than three days without first ob-
taining permission or a medical certificate he will
be treated as having left the service of the Com-
pany. If he subsequently reports for duty he can
only recommence as a new man, that is, he will lose
the benefits of continuity of service, and conse-
quently the Spring Holiday bonus for that particular
year. Exception will be made to this regulation
only in the event of a satisfactory explanation
being given for any such absence, but special appro-
val will be required in each case to obtain con-
tinuity of service.

10月1日至4月30日：

Fearon Road（音译）——
周一至周六（含）上午9:00 至 上午11:30。

Riverside（音译）——
周一至周五（含）下午2:00 至 下午5:00。
周六上午9:00 至 中午12:00。

诊疗所在星期日及公共假日关闭。

(a) 送院治疗：需注意，涉及华籍雇员时，除非有特殊理由需送往医院（如公伤，或需住院治疗的病例），否则应将其送往其中一所诊疗所接受治疗；在此类情况下，应将其送往 Seward Road（西华德路）159号的圣路加医院（St. Luke's Hospital），或 Shantung Road（山东路）310号的 Lester Chinese Hospital（莱斯特华人医院）。

(b) 正式华籍职员的医疗及住院治疗：

医院的普通费用由本公司支付，但除非事先经总经理批准，否则不支付特殊病房、特殊治疗或手术的费用。

本公司保留在华籍雇员患病期间终止其服务的权利，在此情况下，医院费用的支付将立即停止。在此类终止服务的情况下，华籍职员办公室将立即书面通知相关医院。

(c) 缺勤：

按月计薪者缺勤超过六周，按日计薪者缺勤超过四周（凭证明的病假或其他原因），其所在部门负责人必须向相关部门主管报告，以便决定是否宜予遣散（invaliding）；未经特别批准，在上述期限届满后不得发放工资。

如果雇员在未事先获得许可或医疗证明的情况下缺勤超过三天，将被视为已离开本公司服务。如果他随后报到上班，只能作为新人重新开始，即他将失去连续服务的福利，从而失去当年的春节奖金。仅在对任何此类缺勤给出令人满意的解释时，才可对此规定作出例外处理，但在每种情况下均需特别批准才能获得连续服务资格。

In case a regular employee is unable because of
illness to report for duty, or who, on the termina-
tion of sick leave previously granted is prevented
from returning to duty or attending the appropriate
dispensary owing to the continuance of sickness,
thereby rendering himself liable to incur the penalty
for absence from duty extending beyond three days
without permission, he should adopt means to notify
the head of his section, who will thereupon inform
the Company's doctor. The doctor will then take
the earliest opportunity of investigating the case
by visiting the employee concerned, and either re-
commend the requisite sick leave or, if necessary
and possible, removal to hospital. It should be
noted that the Company will not provide medical
treatment for an employee at his home.

(a) PAY DURING SICKNESS:

During absence on certified sick leave full pay
will be granted to regular Chinese employees as
follows:

Monthly rate men - not exceeding six weeks.
Daily rate men - not exceeding four weeks.

All regular Chinese staff on monthly and daily rates
of pay, who are paid full wages during absence on
certified sick leave, must be sent to one of the
Company's dispensaries or to St. Luke's or the Lester
Chinese Hospital, and will be paid only on production
of a certificate from the doctor to the effect that
such leave is necessary, and, further, only for such
period as may be recommended by the doctor and ap-
proved by the head of the section concerned.

All certificates must be on the form provided by the
Company which must be signed by the section head
prior to presentation to the doctor. The doctor's
report and recommendation must be handed by the man
to the head of the section concerned.

Venereal disease: No sick leave with pay will be
granted in cases of absence due to venereal disease.

3. ENGAGEMENTS, DISCHARGES, AND DISMISSALS:

Form No. 28F-09 "Employment authorization and per-
sonal service record" will be used to record, and
obtain authorization for, all engagements, discharges,
and dismissals. Should any member of the foreign
or local supervisory staff consider it necessary,
he may suspend a man and thereafter refer the matter
to the head of his section or department for consi-
deration. Summary dismissal is not permitted.

4. MEDICAL EXAMINATION AND VACCINATION:

All Chinese employees must be medically examined
(and vaccinated, if necessary) by the Company's doc-
tor before engagement, with the exception that this
rule shall not apply in the case of men who are en-
gaged temporarily and whose engagement is therefore
of a "casual" nature and unlikely to extend beyond
a period of a few weeks.
page_data.zh:

如果正式雇员因病无法报到上班，或在先前批准的病假结束时因病情持续而无法返回工作岗位或前往相应的诊疗所，从而导致其面临因未经许可缺勤超过三天而受处罚的风险，他应采取手段通知其部门负责人，后者随即通知本公司医生。医生将尽早通过探访相关雇员来调查此案，并建议必要的病假，或在必要且可能的情况下，将其移送医院。需注意，本公司不提供上门医疗服务。

(a) 病假工资：

在凭证明的病假期间，正式华籍雇员将获得全额工资，具体如下：

按月计薪者——不超过六周。
按日计薪者——不超过四周。

所有在凭证明的病假期间领取全额工资的按月和按日计薪的正式华籍职员，必须被送往本公司的某一诊疗所，或圣路加医院（St. Luke's）或莱斯特华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），并且仅在出示医生证明表明此类休假是必要的情况下方可获付工资，此外，仅限医生推荐并经相关部门负责人批准的期限。

所有证明必须使用本公司提供的表格，该表格在呈交医生前必须由部门负责人签字。医生的报告和建议必须由员工交给相关部门负责人。

性病：因性病导致的缺勤，不给予带薪病假。

3. 聘用、解雇和开除：

第 28F-09 号表格“聘用授权及个人服务记录”将用于记录并获得所有聘用、解雇和开除的授权。如果任何外籍或本地管理人员认为有必要，他可以暂停某人的工作，随后将此事项提交给其部门或科室负责人审议。不允许即时开除（Summary dismissal）。

4. 体检和疫苗接种：

所有华籍雇员在受聘前必须由本公司医生进行体检（并在必要时接种疫苗），但此规则不适用于临时雇用的人员，因为其雇用性质属于“临时性”，且不太可能持续超过几周。

All Chinese employees must be re-vaccinated against
small pox at regular intervals of not longer than
three years. In the event of any Chinese employee
refusing to be re-vaccinated he will lose all
benefits to which he would otherwise be entitled
should he at any time contract smallpox. Re-vaccina-
tion will be carried out and recorded by the Com-
pany's doctor and his staff.

5. RESIDENCE:

If required to do so by the Company, Chinese employees
must reside within districts specified for the con-
venience of working.

6. INCREASES OF PAY:

(a) Daily-rate men: Increases may be recommended
during the year for those workmen who by dili-
gence and good work are considered to be de-
serving of higher rates of pay.

(b) Monthly-rate men: As a general rule, the rates
of pay for Chinese on monthly rates are con-
sidered only at the end of each year.

(c) Instructions regarding recommendations for
increases in pay: It is necessary to emphasize
that the mere fact that a man has carried out
his duties satisfactorily does not entitle him
to an increase if it is considered that his
present pay is sufficient for the class of
work performed.

(d) Procedure: Form No. 28F-39 will be used to
record, and obtain authorization for, all in-
creases of pay.

7. TESTIMONIALS TO CHINESE EMPLOYEES:

No testimonials may be given on the Company's forms
or letter headings, it having always been the policy
of the Company not to issue testimonials to Chinese
employees. The Company may, however, at its dis-
cretion, answer inquiries from prospective employers.

8. ACCEPTANCE OF PRESENTS:

The attention of the supervisory staff is directed
to the necessity of an unqualified refusal to accept
presents emanating from individual members or
groups of the Chinese staff.

9. CONTRACTING OF LOANS:

The contracting of monetary loans between employees
is not permitted and would be regarded as a serious
offence against the interests of the Company.

10. CASUAL LABOR:

The conditions applicable to this grade are as follows:-

(a) Notice and paying off: Minimum notice to be one
hour. Men finishing one day to be paid up on
the following afternoon. The Chinese Staff
Office to be notified the afternoon the men are
finishing and time sheets to be in early the
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

所有华籍雇员必须每隔不超过三年重新接种一次天花疫苗。如有任何华籍雇员拒绝重新接种，若其在任何时候感染天花，将失去原本有权享有的所有福利。重新接种将由本公司医生及其工作人员执行并记录。

5. 居住：

如果本公司要求，华籍雇员必须居住在指定的区域内，以便于工作。

6. 加薪：

(a) 按日计薪者：年内可建议为那些因勤奋和工作出色而被认为值得更高工资率的工人加薪。

(b) 按月计薪者：一般而言，华籍按月计薪者的工资率仅在每年年底予以考虑。

(c) 关于加薪建议的指示：有必要强调，仅仅因为某人满意地履行了其职责，并不使其有权获得加薪，如果认为其目前的工资对于所从事的工作类别已经足够的话。

(d) 程序：第 28F-39 号表格将用于记录并获得所有加薪的授权。

7. 给华籍雇员的推荐信：

不得在本公司的表格或信头上出具推荐信，因为本公司一贯的政策是不向华籍雇员出具推荐信。然而，本公司可自行决定回复未来雇主的查询。

8. 接受礼物：

提请管理人员注意，必须无条件拒绝接受来自华籍职员个人或团体赠送的礼物。

9. 借贷：

不允许雇员之间进行金钱借贷，这将被视为严重损害本公司利益的行为。

10. 临时工（Casual Labor）：

适用于此等级的条件如下：

(a) 通知和解雇结算：最短通知时间为一小时。当天完工的人员应在次日下午结清工资。华籍职员办公室应在人员完工的当天下午收到通知，工时单应在次日清晨尽早提交——

page_data.en:
- 7 -

following morning.- Pay should not be held over
week-ends and holidays and arrangements to be
made accordingly,

(b) Spring Holiday Bonus: Not paid.

(c) Death due to accident while legitimately employed:
We pay funeral allowance. A death gratuity may
be issued at the discretion of the Company.

(d) Death (not on duty): No allowance whatever.

(e) Injury on duty: We provide medical treatment,
sick pay, and hospital expenses. An invaliding
gratuity may be issued at the discretion of the
Company.

(f) Sickness other than injury on duty: No medical
treatment, sick pay, hospital expenses, or
invaliding gratuity.

(g) Pay increases: No service increase, but pay
will go up pro rata with any general increase.

(h) Holidays: No payment for 'holidays with pay'.
If working on 'holidays with pay' will get
overtime rates only, (e.g., at the Spring Holiday
would get double, not triple pay).

(i) Retirement gratuity: None.

(j) Overtime: Usual rates apply.

(k) Caps or hats: Not provided.

(l) Badges: Special badges to be provided and worn
on duty.

(m) Transfer: If transferred to regular staff, pre-
vious service not to be taken into account.

(n) Pay: To be $0.05 per day more than minimum
coolie rate.

November 6, 1933.
（批：baltman）
Police Constable No.232.

Sir,

The oppression by the Imperialists and capitalists
being intolerable, the 2,000 workers attached to this
Union (the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union) have been on strike for over a month. The
dispute has not yet been settled on account of the
stubborn attitude of the management. It is essential
to observe unity until our object is attained, and we
are very grateful to the people in various walks of
life who are in sympathy with us and render us assistance.
We believe that you have already learned such from the
press.

Information from members of this Union shows that
you are busily recruiting new hands on behalf of the
management. This act on your part breaks the unity
of the workers and is detrimental to the personal
benefits of the 2,000 labourers. We cannot help
feeling very indignant about the matter.

So we write to inform you that you, being a Chinese
citizen, should work for the glory of the nation and
render a little assistance to us instead of allowing
yourself to be utilized as a tool by the foreigners.
You are expected to cease such recruiting task without
further delay for the sake of the grace of the nation
and the 2,000 workers attached to this Union.

Hoping to hear from you at an early date.

Whole body of workers of the
New and Old Plants.
page_data.zh:
1933 年 11 月 6 日。
（批注：baltman）
第 232 号巡捕。

先生：

帝国主义者和资本家的压迫令人无法忍受，本工会（第四区水电工会）所属的 2,000 名工人已罢工一个多月。由于资方态度顽固，纠纷尚未解决。在达到我们的目标之前，必须保持团结，我们非常感谢社会各界同情并给予我们援助的人士。相信你们已从报章上得知此事。

本工会会员提供的消息显示，你正忙于代表资方招募新员工。你的这一行为破坏了工人的团结，损害了这 2,000 名劳工的个人利益。对此事我们不能不感到十分愤慨。

因此，我们致函通知你，身为中国公民，应为国家的荣耀工作，并给予我们一点帮助，而不是让自己被外国人利用为工具。为了国家的体面和本工会所属的 2,000 名工人，希望你立即停止此类招募工作。

盼早日复函。

新老厂全体工人

Subject (in full) Anonymous letters in connection with the Shanghai
Power Company.

Made by D.S. Tilton Forwarded by [签名]

In accordance with instructions in connection with the
two attached anonymous letters, inquiries at the Ve Yah
Restaurant at No. 473/4 Foochow Road revealed that on October 31
a wedding reception was held during the evening at which some
200 guests attended at the invitation of a Mr. Chang, aged
about 30 years, a native of Ningpo. The management are unable
to furnish us with further particulars regarding this individual
as the reception was a cash transaction.

No information could be obtained as regards the attendance
at this reception of a person named Fu Tsu Yung (傅子雲) alias
Chou Tien Sheng (周天生) as mentioned in the letters. Further-
more a perusal of the files relating to the strike and subsequent
events of the Shanghai Power Company did not disclose any
information regarding such a person as connected with these
activities and no such names can be found in the list of employees
at the Head Office of the Shanghai Power Company.

Discreet enquiries were also pursued with the co-operation
of C.D.I. Robertson of Louza Station regarding this individual
and his alleged connection with a "detective inspector" attached
to Louza Station. No further information was obtained as the
result of these enquiries and the identity of both the individual
mentioned, and the author of the letters remains unknown.

That the two letters were written by the same person can
be believed, as further to the letters being related, the hand-
writing is similar in both letters. In view of these enquiries
the information contained in the first anonymous letter appears
to be false and was written maliciously as mentioned in the
second letter.

[签名]
Officer i/c Special Branch.

[签名]
D. S.

由特务科副督察长 D.S. Tilton 撰写，由 [签名] 转呈

根据关于所附两封匿名信件的指示，对福州路 473/4 号维亚（Ve Yah）餐馆进行的查询显示，10 月 31 日晚在该处举行了一场婚礼招待会，约有 200 名客人应邀出席，邀请人为一名张姓男子，约 30 岁，宁波籍。由于该招待会是现金交易，管理层无法向我们提供关于此人的更多详情。

关于信中提到的名为傅子云（Fu Tsu Yung），别名周天生（Chou Tien Sheng）的人是否出席了此次招待会，未能获得任何信息。此外，查阅有关上海电力公司罢工及随后事件的档案，并未发现与此类活动有关的此人信息，在上海电力公司总办事处的雇员名单中也找不到这些名字。

在老闸巡捕房（Louza Station）刑事侦缉督察 Robertson 的配合下，也就此人及其据称与老闸巡捕房一名“侦探督察”的关系进行了谨慎的调查。调查结果未获得进一步信息，上述个人及信件作者的身份仍然未知。

可以相信这两封信是由同一人所写，因为除了内容相关外，两封信的笔迹相似。鉴于这些调查，第一封匿名信中包含的信息似乎是虚假的，正如第二封信中所述，是出于恶意而写的。

[签名]
特务科主管警官。

[签名]
D. S.

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。
10 月 20 日遭枪击受伤的职员陈庆禄（Zung Ching Loh）正在稳步康复。既然他说话已不会导致伤势复杂化，警方不时对他进行讯问，但他并未补充已有信息。

Date November 7, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Wounean OSS

The situation at the various depots and plants of
the Company remains unchanged this morning.
Zung Ching-loh (陳慶祿), staff employee, who
was shot and wounded on October 20, is now out of danger
and will soon be fit to leave the hospital.
Of the 400 men who presented themselves at
Riverside Power Station yesterday seeking to take the places
of workers on strike, 75 were questioned and told to
return this morning. The total number to present themselves
to-day for final selection is 209, but it is doubtful if
those taken on will be permitted to commence work for a few
days owing to the prevalence of intimidation.
300 men in search of work have presented themselves
at the Riverside plant this morning and about 50 at the
Fearon Road Depot.
6 further temporary Russians have been taken on
at Fearon Road during the past 24 hours and it is the Company's
intention to take on a number at Riverside to form a skeleton
shift-gang against the possible disaffection of the Chinese
operating staff.
In addition to the two persons arrested for intimidation
by Yangtsepoo Station at 7.05 a.m. November 6, another arrest
for a similar offence was made at 10 a.m. November 6 on
Yangshow Road. All concerned have been charged and will
appear at Court this morning.

D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

今晨，该公司各堆栈和工厂的局势保持不变。
职员陈庆禄（Zung Ching-loh）于10月20日遭枪击受伤，目前已脱离危险，不久即可出院。
昨日前往杨树浦发电厂求职以顶替罢工工人岗位的400人中，有75人接受了问询，并被告知于今晨返回。今日前来参加最终选拔的总人数为209人，但由于恐吓行为盛行，被录用者能否在几天内开始工作尚存疑。
今晨，有300名求职者来到杨树浦电厂，另有约50人来到斐伦路（Fearon Road）堆栈。
在过去24小时内，斐伦路又录用了6名临时俄籍员工，公司打算在杨树浦也录用一批人，组成骨干轮班小组，以防中国运营人员可能出现的异心。
除了杨树浦分局于11月6日上午7时05分逮捕的两名涉嫌恐吓的人员外，上午10时在扬州路（Yangshow Road）又因类似罪行逮捕了一人。所有涉案人员均已被起诉，将于今晨出庭受审。

副督察

Date November 6, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature]

The situation at the various depots and
plants of the Company remains unchanged this morning.
The Chinese on shift work at Riverside Station
are so far unaffected, but it is anticipated that they will
leave their work if the Company carry out their declared
intention of employing new hands to take the places of
those men on strike. Agitation has been carried out
by strikers and their sympathizers among the shift workers
week
during the past/and it is feared that the sympathy of the
majority lie with their idle countrymen.
This morning, 400 men seeking to take the
places of strikers, presented themselves at the Riverside
Power Station. Among these men were a number of strikers
whose object in being there was obviously to intimidate
would-be strike breakers.
Several minor cases of intimidation by
strikers occurred this morning. One such incident on
Tungting Road at 7.05 a.m. resulted in two men being
arrested, by Japanese members of the Municipal Police
assisted by a foreign employee of the Shanghai Power Company.
These two men were taken to Yangtszepoo Station and
charged.
So far thirty men have applied to the Fearon
Road Depot for work.

[Signature]
D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

今晨，该公司各堆栈和工厂的局势保持不变。
目前在杨树浦分局轮班工作的华籍员工尚未受到影响，但预计如果公司执行其已宣布的雇佣新人顶替罢工工人的意图，他们将离职。在过去一周里，罢工者及其同情者在轮班工人中进行了煽动活动，令人担忧的是，大多数人的同情心倾向于他们那些无所事事的同胞。
今晨，400名试图顶替罢工者岗位的人出现在杨树浦发电厂。这些人中包括一些罢工者，他们出现在那里的目的显然是为了恐吓企图破坏罢工的人。
今晨发生了几起罢工者实施的轻微恐吓案件。其中一起发生在上午7时05分的洞庭路（Tungting Road），导致两人被捕，抓捕行动由工部局警务处的日籍警员在上海电力公司一名外籍员工的协助下完成。这两人被带往杨树浦分局并被起诉。
截至目前，已有三十人向斐伦路堆栈申请工作。

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.

Zung Ching-loh (陈庆禄), wounded employee,
continues to make good progress towards recovery.

On November 3, about 300 men presented themselves
at Riverside Power Station seeking employment in the places
of those on strike. 82 were chosen and their particulars
taken after which they were given each a chit, and told to
return on Tuesday, November 7. Thirteen men applied for
work at Fearon Road Depot on November 3, the same procedure
being followed as at Riverside.

This morning, November 4, 400 men, very few if any
of them being old employees of the Company are at Riverside
Power Station looking for work, up to 9 a.m. 40 men had
been chosen.

Hsu Shing-loh, General Manager of the National
Commercial Bank, L.T. Yuen, Chinese advisor to the S.M.C.
and Wong Shaio-lai, Chairman of the Chamber of Commerce,
together with numerous other prominent Chinese have formed
a committee and have approached the management of the
Shanghai Power Company with regard to an early settlement
of the existing dispute, Hsu Shing-loh and L.T. Yuen in an
interview with Mr. Hopkins, President of the Company, stated
that they could get the men back to work if the Company
would promise to negotiate a settlement at an early date.

Mr. Hopkins advised the two gentlemen that as the Company
could not see its way clear to altering its attitude regarding
its obligations to its workers it would not be politic for
them to engage in a discussion or mediation likely to

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。

受伤员工陈庆禄（Zung Ching-loh）继续良好康复。

11月3日，约300人前往杨树浦发电厂求职，以顶替罢工者的空缺。其中82人被选中，在登记个人资料后，每人发给一张纸条，并告知于11月7日星期二返回。11月3日，有13人在斐伦路堆栈申请工作，程序与杨树浦相同。

今晨，11月4日，多达上午9时，有400人在杨树浦发电厂寻找工作，其中极少（如果有）是公司的老员工。已有40人被选中。

国家商业银行总经理徐星洛（Hsu Shing-loh，音译）、工部局华人顾问袁履登（L.T. Yuen，音译）以及商会主席王晓籁（Wong Shaio-lai，音译）与其他众多知名华人组成委员会，并就尽早解决现有纠纷一事接触上海电力公司管理层。徐星洛和袁履登在与公司董事长霍普金斯（Hopkins）先生会晤时表示，如果公司承诺尽早谈判解决，他们可以让工人们复工。

霍普金斯先生建议两位绅士，由于公司认为无法改变其对工人义务的态度，因此他们参与可能导致失败的讨论或调解是不明智的，因为这种失败只会使局势复杂化。

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
Zung Ching-loh (陳慶祿), staff employee who
was shot and wounded on October 20, continues to make
progress towards recovery.
As the result of the notices posted by the
management on its various premises relative to the employment candidates for positions vacated by strikers
of new hands, three hundred men presented themselves at
Riverside Power Station Time-office this morning. Likely
men will be picked out and instructed to call again on
Tuesday, November 7.
Information was obtained from the offices of the
Company on November 2, that agitators were at work among the
operating staff at Riverside Power Station in an endeavour
to bring them out on strike in sympathy with the Workshop
and Distribution hands. It is generally believed, however,
that the men do not wish to leave their work, but may be
forced to if intimidation is resorted to.
The Strike Committee of the Shanghai Power Company
workers claim that they have so far not brought out the
operating staff purely out of consideration for the
employees and workers in staple trades such as cotton
manufacture, etc. whose livelihood depends on an uninterrupted
supply of power. The representatives of the strikers have
played on this particular point when soliciting funds from
the Cotton Mill Workers Union and other people.
The Management of the Shanghai Power Company
have been approached during the past two weeks by
representatives of large firms of cotton manufacturers

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

D.S.I. Golder

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains
unchanged this morning. Sixteen meter-men from
Fearon Road Depot, who had resumed since Monday, October 30,
left the premises last evening but gave no intimation as to
their intentions.

With reference to my report dated November 1
on the subject of notices posted by the management in
connection with the employment of new hands to take the
place of those on strike, such notices were posted at
Fearon Road at 6 p.m. yesterday but were not posted at
Riverside owing to the fact that they arrived after the
works-office had been closed.

Zung Ching Ish (陈庆林), staff employee of
the Company who was shot and wounded on October 20 continues
to progress towards recovery.

Attached hereto will be found lists of addresses
of loyal workers who the Company feel will be the objects
of intimidation and for whom the management have asked a
little extra protection.

It is expected that when the Company commences to
take on new hands on Friday, November 3, efforts will be
made by strikers to prevent prospective workers from
approaching the Company's premises. In this connection
the Company have intimated that a few extra police might
be posted in the vicinity of Fearon Road and Riverside
Power Stations.

Reference the French Police Intelligence Report
for October 30, relative to the taking men to the Fearon
Road Depot in motor cars. Some 17 men delivered of

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE L. & S. E. REGISTRY. File No. ... No. D 33 / ...）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [签名]

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains
unchanged this morning. Sixteen meter-men from
Fearon Road Depot, who had resumed since Monday, October 30,
left the premises last evening but gave no intimation as to
their intentions.

With reference to my report dated November 1
on the subject of notices posted by the management in
connection with the employment of new hands to take the
place of those on strike, such notices were posted at
Fearon Road at 6 p.m. yesterday but were not posted at
Riverside owing to the fact that they arrived after the
works-office had been closed.

Zung Ching Ioh (陳广祿), staff employee of
the Company who was shot and wounded on October 20 continues
to progress towards recovery.

Attached hereto will be found lists of addresses
of loyal workers who the Company feel will be the objects
of intimidation and for whom the management have asked a
little extra protection.

It is expected that when the Company commence to
take on new hands on Friday, November 3, efforts will be
made by strikers to prevent prospective workers from
approaching the Company's premises. In this connection
the Company have intimated that a few extra police might
be posted in the vicinity of Fearon Road and Riverside
Power Stations.

for October 30, relative to the taking men to the Fearon
Road Depot in motor cars. Some 17 men desirous of

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 局势

撰写人：特别分部主管 Golder 转交人 [签名]

今晨江边发电厂的局势保持不变。自10月30日（星期一）起已恢复工作的十六名来自斐伦路仓库的电表员，于昨晚离开了场所，但未透露其意图。

关于我11月1日就管理层张贴有关雇佣新人以替代罢工者的通告一事所提交的报告，此类通告已于昨日下午6时在斐伦路张贴，但由于送达时办公室已关闭，故未在江边发电厂张贴。

该公司职员陈广祿（Zung Ching Ioh）于10月20日遭枪击受伤，目前继续康复中。

随函附上公司认为将成为恐吓对象的忠诚工人地址名单，管理层已请求对这些人员给予额外保护。

预计当公司于11月3日（星期五）开始雇佣新人时，罢工者将设法阻止潜在工人接近公司场所。对此，公司表示可能在斐伦路和江边发电厂附近增派少量警力。

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by J.W. Prine C.S.I.

The situation in Riverside Power Station
remains unchanged this morning. 41 of the 574 operatives
on strike at the Fearon Road Depot resumed work on
October 30 and 31 thus reducing the total of men affected
to 1475.

During the twenty four hours ending 8 a.m.
November 1, five cases of intimidation were reported by
the management. The particulars of these cases were
telephoned to the Station concerned. In each case
a male Chinese arrived on a bicycle during the absence
of the actual Shanghai Power Company employee and
informed the man's wife that the pickets would be
there soon unless her husband stopped working. Threats
were made to kidnap the men's children, etc. The

Date October 31, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature]

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains
unchanged this morning. As to the Fearon Road Depot
operatives, by 12 noon yesterday, October 30, 23 regular
hands and 60 casual labourers had entered the plant.
The regular workmen offered to start work but the 60
labourers asked to be recognized as the breakers of the
strike and requested that they receive preferential
treatment at the hands of the management. Mr. Hunter,
Engineer i/c of Fearon Road, was instructed to tell them
that the Company was not intending to make any concessions
to its employees but that it would pay for a mid-day meal
for all those willing to work. Upon learning that
nothing beyond the meal was forthcoming all 60 left the
Depot claiming that they would have to talk it over. The
twenty three regular men have been augmented by six others
this morning, all have offered to start work.

The Company is confident that if even from small
beginnings the men can start work without fear of
interference, it will only be a few days before the whole
of the Fearon Road workmen are back. Despite the attempt
to break the strike yesterday and the presence of some
200 men in the vicinity of Fearon Road Depot, no cases
of intimidation are reported.

Zung Ching-leh (陳慶), employee of the
Company who was shot on October 20, continues to make
progress towards recovery. In connection with the
attempted murder of this man, careful enquiries have
been made but little or nothing has been learned as to
his assailants.

主题（全称） 上海电力公司 - 局势。

由 特别分部督察 Golder 制作 转呈 [签名]

今晨杨树浦发电站的局势保持不变。至于斐伦路堆栈的工人，截至昨日（10月30日）中午12时，已有23名正式工和60名临时工进入厂区。正式工表示愿意开始工作，但这60名临时工要求被承认为破坏罢工者，并要求管理层给予他们优待。斐伦路负责工程师亨特先生奉命告诉他们，公司不打算向其雇员做出任何让步，但将为所有愿意工作的人提供午餐。当得知除了午餐外没有其他待遇时，这60人全部离开了堆栈，声称他们需要商量一下。今早又有六人加入那二十三名正式工的行列，所有人都表示愿意开始工作。

公司确信，即使是从微小的开端做起，只要工人们能够不受干扰地开始工作，不出几天，斐伦路的所有工人都会回来。尽管昨天试图破坏罢工，且斐伦路堆栈附近有约200人，但未报告发生恐吓案件。

公司雇员陈庆（Zung Ching-leh）于10月20日遭枪击，目前仍在康复中。就此人遇刺未遂一案，已进行仔细调查，但对其袭击者知之甚少或一无所获。

Intelligence Report dated 27/10/33
----------
Shanghai Power Company - Situation
Doo Yueh-sung, member of the Control Committee of
the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and also President of
the French Concession Chinese Ratepayers' Association,
held a meeting at his home at 216 Rue Wagner on October 26,
inviting Loh Ching-dz, member of the Executive Committee
of the local Tangpu, and Chu Hsueh-fan, member of the
General Labour Union, to discuss the Shanghai Power
Company Strike Situation, and any possible means to
settle the dispute. The situation was described
clearly before Mr. Doo Yueh-sung at this meeting.
------
Mr. Li Cheng Tso, representing the Central Tangpu,
arrived in Shanghai on October 26, to try to find a
means of solving the problem of settling the Shanghai
Power Company strike. He went straight to the
local offices of the Kuomintang and to the Bureau of
Social Affairs, to obtain details of the strike situation.
At 2 p.m. he summoned Zee Hung-sung and Nyi Wen-foo,
representatives of the Shanghai Power Company Workers'
General Labour Union, to get their views on the matter.
------
Mr. Pan Hwa-Kuo, Chief of the Workers' Section
of the Ministry of Industry, left for Nanking at 11 p.m.
October 26 after he had completed his enquiries into
the Shanghai Power Company strike situation.
Commr. of Police.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature] C.S.I.

The situation in the Shanghai Power Company
shows slight improvement to-day October 30. As the
result of the failure of the Union to pay strike-pay to
the majority of the strikers, about 150 workmen from the
Fearon Road Depot have, during the past few days, shown a
desire to resume work. This morning groups of workmen
have appeared in the vicinity of the Depot but only 15 have entered
and expressed
a desire to start. The remainder numbering about 140 men
are waiting in tea shops afraid to approach the Depot for
fear of intimidation. Representations of the management
are canvassing the district in an attempt to persuade the men
that adequate police are available for their protection.

Information obtained by Agents 57, 51 and 50.

Forty members of the 4th District Water and
Electricity Workers' Union at a meeting held between 7 p.m.
and 9 p.m. October 28 in their office, 15 Shou Ying Faung,
Tien Doong Road, Chapei, passed the following resolutions :-
1. That the strikers be warned to attend the office of the
Union every morning, and that they be struck from member-
ship after the settlement of the present strike if they
ignore the warning.
2. That efforts be made to request Tu Yueh-sung (杜月笙)
and Yung Tsong-ching (榮宗敬) to bring about an early
settlement of the dispute through mediation.
3. That all workers persist in the strike at any cost.
4. That the Chinese Authorities be asked to investigate
and suppress communist activities among the workers
of the Power Company who are at present on strike.

At 10 a.m. October 28, one Li Zung-tse (李人祝),
member of the People's Movement Committee of the Central

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Doo Yueh-sung and

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature] C.S.I.

With reference to the query by the Commissioner
of Police and remarks of the Officer i/c Special Branch,
I have to state that during the strike of the China
Times employees in April, May and June, 1932, a follower
of Doo Yueh-sung's, namely Mao Yu-feng (毛剛峯),
was a prominent agitator and it is known that he met
various of Doo's followers in lodging houses and low
class hotels. It is of importance to note that the
dispute was eventually carried to "Doo" who settled
it after some $11,000 had been paid over.

Further evidence of the activities of the man
in question is contained in the reports submitted
by the undersigned in connection with the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Factory dispute. Doo in this case
was baulked of his prey by a split in the ranks of his
lieutenants, who in view of the large sum of money
involved ($400,000.00) fought among themselves as to
its subsequent division.

Zung Ching-loh (陳慶祿), wounded employee,

Reference my report dated October 25 relative
to the alleged invitation of Doo Yueh-sung (杜月笙) to
mediate in the Shanghai Power Company dispute. Enquiries
show that Doo Yueh-sung attended the office of Mr. Fessenden
during the afternoon of October 24 at the request of Chu
Hsueh-fan (朱學範), who in approaching Doo stated that he
represented the strikers of the Shanghai Power Company.
Doo Yueh-sung during his conversation with Mr. Fessenden,
which was interpreted by Tsai Foh Dong (蔡福棠), confidential
employee of the legal firm of Fessenden and Halcomb, stated
that his effort to settle the trouble had been prompted by
his desire to maintain peace and order. No conclusion was
arrived at on October 24 but "Doo" called on Mr. Fessenden
again yesterday when he was requested to prepare terms of
settlement. Since Doo Yueh-sung's name has been connected
with enquiry it is of interest to note that "Doo" is
reported to have approached the management some days ago
with an offer to settle the existing dispute.
Since the attempted murder of Zung Ching-loh
on October 20, there have been no further cases of
intimidation reported. Enquiries into the shooting have
produced no useful information, the strikers, however,
through their union have taken every opportunity to disclaim
